recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Steak Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A hearty slow-cooker chili with beef round steak, kidney beans, and a thickened sauce.

instructions.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat; add beef, onion and garlic. Cook until beef is browned and onion and garlic are translucent.
Drain; transfer beef mixture to a large slow cooker.
Add one cup water, celery, beans, tomatoes with juice, salsa, sauce and seasonings; stir.
Cover and cook on low setting for 8 hours.
Shortly before serving time, place flour, cornmeal and remaining water in a small bowl; whisk until smooth.
Add mixture to simmering chili; stir for 2 minutes, until thickened.
Garnish as desired.

recipes.title: The Great Pumpkin Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A unique fall-inspired chili featuring canned pumpkin with honey and a touch of sweetness.

instructions.text: Brown beef in a large stockpot over medium heat, stirring to crumble; drain.
Stir in tomatoes with juice and remaining ingredients; reduce heat to low.
Simmer, covered, for one to 2 hours, adding water as necessary.

recipes.title: Cincinnati-Style Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: Classic Cincinnati chili with warm spices like cinnamon, allspice, and nutmeg, served over spaghetti.

instructions.text: Combine uncooked beef and water in a large stockpot.
Add remaining ingredients except spaghetti and cheese.
Simmer over medium heat for 3 hours, stirring often.
Discard bay leaves.
Serve chili ladled over spaghetti and topped with cheese.

recipes.title: Garlicky Green Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A flavorful green chili with pork, green chiles, and fresh cilantro.

instructions.text: In a Dutch oven over medium heat, brown pork in oil.
Mix in flour; cook and stir for one minute.
Add garlic, salt and pepper; cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in remaining ingredients; simmer for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Ivan's Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A traditional from-scratch chili using dried kidney beans, slow-simmered for hours.

instructions.text: In a stockpot, cover beans with water and soak overnight; drain and rinse.
Return beans to pan; cover with fresh water. Bring to a boil over medium heat; reduce heat and simmer until beans are tender, 4 to 5 hours.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and seasonings.
In a skillet over medium heat, sauté onion and garlic in oil.
Add beef and Worcestershire sauce; cook until browned.
Drain; add beef mixture to beans. Simmer, uncovered, for 1-1/2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Crowd-Pleasing Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A large-batch chili perfect for feeding a crowd, using tomato soup and onion soup mix.

instructions.text: Brown beef in a Dutch oven over medium heat; drain.
Add remaining ingredients except cheese and crackers or corn chips.
Simmer for 1-1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle servings with cheese; serve with crackers or corn chips.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Chicken Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A creamy slow-cooker chicken chili with Great Northern beans and cream of chicken soup.

instructions.text: Combine all ingredients except cumin, chiles and hot pepper sauce in a slow cooker; mix well.
Heat on low setting for 8 to 10 hours, until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork.
Stir in remaining ingredients; heat through.

recipes.title: WWII Mess Hall Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A hearty from-scratch chili using dried pinto beans, beef and pork, with lots of seasonings.

instructions.text: In a Dutch oven, cover beans with water and soak overnight; drain and rinse. Return beans to Dutch oven; cover with fresh water.
Cook over medium-low heat until nearly tender. In a skillet over medium heat, sauté onion and green peppers in half of the margarine and oil.
Add remaining margarine and oil; sauté beef and pork until browned.
Drain; add meat mixture and remaining ingredients to beans in Dutch oven.
Simmer for one to 1-1/2 hours, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender. Skim off any fat before serving.

recipes.title: Biffiny's Baked Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: An oven-baked chili with rice that's stirred every 30 minutes for perfect texture.

instructions.text: Brown beef and onion in a skillet over medium heat; drain.
Combine with remaining ingredients in a large oven-safe pot; stir well.
Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 2 to 3 hours, stirring every 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Garden Patch Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A hearty vegetarian chili with bulgur wheat, kidney beans, and fresh vegetables.

instructions.text: Heat oil in a large saucepan or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onions, carrot, pepper, garlic, chili powder and cumin.
Cook, stirring occasionally, over medium-high heat for about 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes with juice and sugar; continue cooking about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat to low; mix in beans and bulgur wheat.
Simmer until thickened, about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili with Corn Dumplings
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A hearty beef chili topped with homemade cornmeal dumplings with cilantro.

instructions.text: Brown ground beef and onion in a Dutch oven over medium heat; drain. Set aside 1/2 cup corn.
Stir remaining corn with liquid, tomatoes with juice, sauces, chili powder and garlic into beef mixture.
Heat to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir together baking mix and cornmeal in a bowl; stir in milk, cilantro and reserved corn just until moistened.
Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto simmering chili. Cook over low heat, uncovered, for 15 minutes.
Cover and cook an additional 15 to 18 minutes, until dumplings are dry on top.

recipes.title: Mexican Vegetable Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A vegetable-forward chili featuring jicama, chili beans, and pinto beans.

instructions.text: In a Dutch oven over medium heat, sauté jicama, onion, celery, carrots, green pepper and garlic in oil until crisp-tender.
Stir in water, bouillon, seasonings and tomato sauce. Add whole tomatoes with juice, cutting or breaking up tomatoes.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover; simmer an additional 10 to 20 minutes, until vegetables are tender.
Stir in beans; simmer until heated through. Serve topped with cheese.

recipes.title: Jan's Prize-Winning Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A contest-worthy chili with green chiles and both pinto and kidney beans.

instructions.text: Brown beef, onion and garlic in a deep skillet over medium heat; drain.
Mix together tomatoes with juice and remaining ingredients except garnish; add to beef mixture.
Cover and cook over low heat for at least one hour, stirring occasionally.
Top servings with shredded cheese, sour cream and minced onion.

notes: Top servings with shredded cheese, sour cream and minced onion.

recipes.title: Smoky White Bean Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A simple slow-cooker chili with mini smoked sausages and Great Northern beans.

instructions.text: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low setting for about 4 hours.

recipes.title: White Chicken Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful white chili with chicken, green chiles, and cannellini beans.

instructions.text: Heat oil in a large saucepan over high heat; add chicken and cook 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often.
Remove chicken with a slotted spoon. Add onion to pan; sauté 2 minutes.
Stir in broth, chiles and spices; simmer 2 minutes.
Add chicken and beans; simmer 5 additional minutes, or until chicken juices run clear.
Garnish with cheese before serving.

notes: Garnish with cheese before serving.

recipes.title: Mom's Firehouse Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A hearty slow-cooker chili with beef chuck roast, kidney beans, and Great Northern beans.

ingredients.item: pepper, garlic powder, dried parsley, chili powder, hot pepper sauce

instructions.text: Place beef, onions and water in a large slow cooker. Add tomatoes with juice and tomato paste; stir well.
Add celery, green pepper and beans. Stir in seasonings to taste; top with corn.
Cover and cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours, or on high setting for 5 to 6 hours, stirring occasionally.

notes: Top with corn.

recipes.title: Texas Beef Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A simple Texas-style slow-cooker chili with stew beef, tomato sauce, and salsa.

instructions.text: Combine all ingredients except green pepper in a slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours.
Stir in green pepper; increase to high setting and cook for an additional 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Lori's Kid-Friendly Chili
recipes.source_note: Circle of Friends Cookbook - Chili Recipes
recipes.description: A mild chili with spaghetti mixed in, perfect for kids and picky eaters.

instructions.text: In a Dutch oven over medium heat, brown beef; drain.
Add both cans of tomatoes with juice, tomato sauce, beans, seasoning mix and water.
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer over low heat for 30 minutes.
While chili is simmering, break half the spaghetti into thirds and cook as directed on package, reserving the rest for a future use. Drain but do not rinse spaghetti.
Add spaghetti to pot. Continue to simmer for another 5 minutes, until chili thickens slightly.

recipes.title: Fattoosh
recipes.description: Traditional Lebanese bread salad with crispy pita, fresh vegetables, sumac, and mint.

instructions.text: Set your oven to 425 degrees before doing anything else.
Put pita in a baking dish. Bake pita for 5 mins in the oven.
Remove the baking dish and set it to the side for cooling. Now break the pita into small pieces.
Grab the following ingredients: green peppers, lettuce, radishes, tomatoes, olives, onions, cucumber and the baked pita pieces.
Put all of the ingredients into a salad bowl and add: salt, mint, and sumac. Toss evenly.
Add some olive oil and lemon juice. Chill the salad in the fridge.
Enjoy.

notes: Chill the salad in the fridge.

recipes.title: Donair
recipes.description: Lebanese-style donair with spiced beef, parsley sauce, and tahini sauce served in pita bread.

instructions.text: Grab a dish ready for baking. Take your beef and place it on the dish.

Get the following items: garlic, red wine vinegar, tomatoes, half a cup of olive oil, salt, juiced lemon, pepper, allspice, cardamom, and cinnamon. Put all contents into a big container and mix together.
Take your seasoning and cover your beef with it, making sure each piece is covered evenly.
Place a lid on your seasoned beef and place everything into the fridge for about four hours to marinate. More time is better.
Now let's get the oven ready. Turn it on to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Once the oven is 425 degrees, grab your dish, take off its lid, and place it into the oven to cook until you notice all the beef is done. This will take about 50 minutes.
Take out the meat and set it to the side for cooling.
Now it's time to make our parsley covering. Grab half a cup of olive oil, parsley, and sweet onions and put all the contents together into a big container for mixing.
Combine with the oil, some tomatoes, and put the mixture to the side to rest for a bit.
Now we need to get another dish to make our tahini. Combine the following items: water, garlic, juiced lemon, tahini, and your preferred amount of salt.
Now we are ready to serve our food. Grab some pita bread and roll its sides upwards.
Put some meat mixture into the pita, with a layer of parsley covering over the top, and finally another layer of tahini.
Place the filled roll on a plate. Serve and enjoy.

notes: Place a lid on your seasoned beef and place everything into the fridge for about four hours to marinate. More time is better.

recipes.title: Labneh (Lebanese Cream Cheese)
recipes.description: Traditional Lebanese strained yogurt cheese, simple to make with just yogurt, salt, and olive oil.

instructions.text: To make this recipe we will first need two things: some cheesecloth for lining a container (preferably a bowl) and a container. So grab these two things.
Now get your yogurt and put it into the cheesecloth lined dish. Also put in your salt with the yogurt.
Now grab a colander and put it in the sink or into the dish to catch anything that drains off from the mixture.
Allow everything to drain for at least twenty four hours ideally. What is left over from draining is our cheese.
Take the remaining contents and put them in another dish suitable for storage.
Combine with the cheese, some olive oil, making sure to mix it in well.
Make sure to put a lid on this container and keep it in the fridge.
Enjoy.

notes: Allow everything to drain for at least twenty four hours ideally.
Make sure to put a lid on this container and keep it in the fridge.

recipes.title: Lebanese Rubbed Salad
recipes.description: A fresh salad with mixed greens, feta cheese, and balsamic vinegar, hand-mixed for even coating.

instructions.text: To begin let's get a big container (possibly a big bowl).
Into our container add the following items: feta cheese, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and some garlic.
Also combine with the items some salt and pepper. Make sure you combine the mixture well by tossing.
Now we want to add some olive oil and vinegar to the mix for extra tastiness.
Now let's make sure we have some clean hands and mix everything together for about two mins.
Our goal is getting the greens nice and evenly covered. Once the greens are coated evenly the dish is ready for plating.
Serve and enjoy.

recipes.title: Kibbee Lebanese Style
recipes.description: Traditional Lebanese kibbee with ground lamb, bulgur wheat, and pine nuts, baked to perfection.

instructions.text: Let's start this recipe by getting our ovens ready for some work. So turn on the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit or 175 degrees Celsius.
Now we need a square container for baking. Preferably this dish should be about 8 inches.

Grab your bulgur and place it into a container for soaking. Place some water that's hot into a container and place your bulgur into the water letting it sit for about 10 minutes. At this point you should notice the bulgur expanding.
Now let's get our food processor and get it ready for some work too.

Take the following items and put them into the processor: lamb, bulgur, parsley, mint, onions, allspice, salt, pepper, and cinnamon. Process everything for about one min to make sure it's nice and smooth.
Grab your baking dish from before and split the lamb mix in half on the dish and make a big patty.
Put some pine nuts over the lamb and then take the remaining lamb meat and cover the pine nuts with the meat. Make sure to compress the patty layers nicely.
Get your kibbee and dice it into one and a half inch squares.
Place the lamb into the oven for about 35 mins. At this point you should not see any pinkness in the meat.
If you have a thermometer the temperature readout should be 160 degrees Fahrenheit or 70 Celsius.
Plate and enjoy.

notes: Preferably this dish should be about 8 inches (pan size).
At this point you should not see any pinkness in the meat.
If you have a thermometer the temperature readout should be 160 degrees Fahrenheit or 70 Celsius.

recipes.title: Lebanese Bean Salad
recipes.description: A hearty three-bean salad with fava beans, chickpeas, and white beans marinated in lemon and garlic.

instructions.text: To make this recipe let's start with a large dish for mixing (possibly a bowl) and place into our container the following items: juiced lemon, fava beans, garlic, chickpeas, olive oil, white beans, and some parsley.
Combine with the mixture some black pepper and some salt.
Put the container in the fridge for about two hrs to let everything marinate and cool off.
Plate, enjoy.

notes: Put the container in the fridge for about two hours to let everything marinate and cool off.

recipes.title: Lebanese Rice Pilaf
recipes.description: Classic Lebanese rice pilaf with orzo pasta, toasted almonds, and tahini.

instructions.text: First we need to get a nice sized container for our rice. Fill the container with water and place the rice into it.
Let everything relax for about 10 mins. Now remove the rice from the water and run cool water over the rice until you notice the water running clear.
Grab a frying pan or skillet and heat the pan with a medium level of heat.
Add 2 tbsps of olive oil with one fourth cup of butter to the pan and mix into the oils some orzo.
Fry your orzo down until you notice it becoming a nice brownish color. This will take about five mins.
Now that the orzo is brown let's grab our rice and increase the level of heat slightly (should be high at this point).
For 5 mins we want to mix into the oil orzo mixture all the rice and continue cooking until we notice that the rice kernels are translucent.
Grab some water and cover the rice with it. Combine with the water and rice some salt and get everything to a boiling point.

Grab a lid and cover the rice. Make sure you turn the heat down to its lowest level and let the rice cook until it becomes fluffy. Make sure to not open the pot while the rice is cooking (we need the pressure to build up inside the pot).
Continue cooking your rice for about 20 mins.
Now grab another frying pan or skillet and get some olive oil hot. Heating level should be medium.

Add some almonds to the oil mix and fry them until they are nice and toasted. You will eventually notice a nice fragrance from the cooked almonds. Overall the almond frying process should take about 5 mins.
Finally we want to add some butter and tahini to the almonds and evenly cover each almond with the mixture.
Combine the almond mixture with the rice and plate the contents. Enjoy.

notes: Let everything relax for about 10 minutes before cooking.

Make sure you turn the heat down to its lowest level and let the rice cook until it becomes fluffy. Make sure to not open the pot while the rice is cooking (we need the pressure to build up inside the pot).
Add some almonds to the oil mix and fry them until they are nice and toasted. You will eventually notice a nice fragrance from the cooked almonds.
Overall the almond frying process should take about 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Lebanese Radish Salad
recipes.description: A refreshing salad with crisp radishes, toasted walnuts, mint ribbons, and honey-lemon dressing.

ingredients.prep_note: trimmed and sliced into thin rounds

instructions.text: To make this salad we first need to grab a frying pan or skillet. Get the pan nice and hot with a medium level of heat and throw into the pan your walnuts.

Cook the walnuts until they are toasted and you smell their nice fragrance. You'll notice the colour of the walnuts change to a darker one when they are ready for the next step. This should take about 4 mins.
Once the walnuts are toasted, we want to dice them nicely.
Grab a container and place into it some radishes.
Grab another container (but smaller) and place the following it: honey, oil, salt, and juiced lemons.
Mix the contents together in the small bowl. Take this mixture and cover the radishes with it evenly. You may want to toss the radishes to get your even coating.
Now we want to grab some mint leaves and place them on top of each other in layers on the counter. Once layered, roll them up, and cut them to create a ribbon like shape.
Take your mint ribbons and combine them with the radishes and the walnuts.
Serve as is. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Layali Libnan
recipes.description: Lebanese Nights - a semolina pudding with rose water, topped with whipped cream, pistachios, and caramel syrup.

instructions.text: Let's begin by grabbing a nice large pan. Put your milk into the pan and heat everything over a medium level of heat. Continue heating your milk until it is boiling.
Once the milk is boiling we want to turn down the heat and begin to mix in our semolina at a slow but consistent rate. Take care to stir consistently.
Now keep stirring for about one to two mins. The milk should still be boiling while stirring and after one to 2 mins you should notice the contents have become thick.
Now we want to remove the pan from the heat.
Combine your eggs and rose water into the milk taking care to stir continually. Now you can either grab one larger serving dish or multiple dishes.

Put some mixture into each dish or into your one large dish. Let the contents cool for a bit and cover the dish(es). Now we want to put the contents into the fridge for at least five hrs (but overnight is ideal).
Now grab another pan and pour some water and sugar into it to begin the syrup creation process.
Heat the pan over a medium level of heat and continually stir the contents allowing the sugar to dissipate.
Continue cooking and stirring until you find the contents are a brownish golden color.
Once the desired color has been achieved remove the pan from its heating source and add the remaining water and stir it in. If your contents get harder do not worry.

Put the pan back on its heating source and add the rest of the sugar and get it to dissipate. Now we want to combine some juiced lemon with the mixture and continue applying heat until everything is boiling.

Let the mixture boil / simmer for about ten mins. After 10 mins of boiling take the pan away from its heating source. Place a lid over the pan and set it aside to cool. This syrup is good for a month if covered and keep cool.
Now before we serve this dish we want to take some whip cream and combine it with some sugar and whip it until it hardens a bit.
Take this whipped cream with sugar and place it over the pudding mixture and put some nuts on top of it.
The pudding should be diced into squares and covered with some caramel syrup for best taste.
Enjoy.

recipes.title: Lebanese Seven Spices
recipes.description: A classic Lebanese spice blend with black pepper, cumin, paprika, coriander, cloves, nutmeg, cinnamon, and cardamom.

instructions.text: Making this amazing spice is quite easy so let's begin by grabbing a container for storage.
Put the following ingredients into the container: cardamom, black pepper, cinnamon, cumin, nutmeg, paprika, clove, and coriander.
Make sure to mix the spices together nicely.
Cover the container with a good lid so no air can penetrate.
Store and enjoy.

recipes.title: Lebanese Style Cookies
recipes.description: Traditional Lebanese cookies with semolina, warm spices, rose water, and orange flower water, shaped into wreaths.

instructions.text: Let's begin by grabbing a pan and heating it with a low level of heat. Grab some butter and melt it down nicely.
Combine some sugar and water with the butter and take care to stir it continually. But make sure that you prevent the mixture from reaching a boiling state.
Get everything combined nicely and take it away from its heating source and allow it to cool.
Grab a container (possibly a bowl) and put in your flour and the following items: sesame seeds, melted butter, spices, and yeast.
Combine the items for about 10 mins by stirring.
Let the dough sit about an hour. Make sure you cover your container.
Now we need to get three baking dishes and get them ready for some work. Spray each dish with non stick cooking spray.
Grab another small container or bowl and mix in your orange flower and rose water. Grab an additional bowl and fill it with some water that is warm.
Now we want to move everything to a flat surface that is covered in flour and begin to remove approx. one cup of dough from the dough container.
You now want to cover your fingers in the warm water and knead the dough for one min.
After kneading the dough for a min dunk it into the flower water and continue to knead it. You should notice the dough is nice and soft eventually.
Roll the soft dough into a foot long rope like shape that should be about one inch deep.
Halve the dough into two pieces and form it into a wreath like shape (basically a circle).
Press the ends of each piece together. Take your soon to be cookies and place them on a baking dish.
Continue to make cookies like this until you have filled a baking dish.
Once the dish is full place it in the fridge over night. The dish should be covered with a towel.
After the dough has set for a night get your oven ready for work by bringing it to 350 degrees Fahrenheit or 175 degrees Celsius.

Before entering your cookies into the oven let them warm up to room temperature. Once at room temperature and the oven is nice and preheated place the cookies into the oven for about 15 mins. After 15 mins the cookies will be nice and brown.
Remove the cookies from the oven. Let cool. Serve. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Lebanese Lemon Salad Dressing
recipes.description: A simple and tangy Lebanese dressing with fresh lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and salt.

instructions.text: This is a very simple, but tasty dressing so let's get started by grabbing a nice sized container for storage (preferably a bowl).
Now combine your items: pepper, juiced lemon, salt, olive oil, and garlic.
Take care to mix everything nicely.
Serve immediately as dressing for all types of salads.
Enjoy.

recipes.title: Lebanese Baked Eggplant
recipes.description: A hearty layered dish with eggplant, seasoned beef, walnuts, potatoes, and stewed tomatoes.

instructions.text: Cut eggplants into 0.5 inch rectangular slices. Salt and let sit for 20 minutes, then drain liquid with paper towel.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Heat a frying pan over medium heat with olive oil. Brown meat and onions together, then add walnuts and cook 2 more minutes. Remove from heat.
In a baking dish, layer half of the eggplant pieces, then the meat mixture, then the rest of the eggplant.
Top with a mixture of tomatoes, potatoes, pepper, and salt.
Bake for about 1 hour until eggplant is soft. Let cool before serving.

recipes.title: Lebanese Lemon Lentil Soup
recipes.description: A hearty lentil soup with vegetables, warm spices, and a creamy flour-butter roux finish.

instructions.text: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Stir fry vegetables for 5 minutes, add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add water, spices, lentils, and parsley. Cover and simmer for 1.5 hours.
Make roux: whisk flour and butter over medium-low heat for 10 minutes until paste forms, then cook until brown (20 min).
Whisk brown paste into soup spoonful by spoonful. Serve with lemon wedges and parsley.

recipes.title: Lebanese Garlic Sauce
recipes.description: A smooth, creamy garlic sauce made by blending garlic with olive oil.

instructions.text: Blend salt, garlic, and lemon juice at medium speed until smooth.
Gradually add olive oil in a slow stream while blending.
Continue until thick. Refrigerate in a sealed container.

recipes.title: Tabouli
recipes.description: A refreshing Lebanese salad of bulgur wheat, fresh herbs, tomatoes, and lemon-olive oil dressing.

instructions.text: Pour boiling water over bulgur, cover and let sit 20 minutes.
Combine bulgur with all other ingredients. Toss and refrigerate 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lebanese Chicken and Potatoes
recipes.description: Crispy baked chicken and potatoes with a lemon-garlic-olive oil sauce.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Place potatoes and chicken in baking dish. Season.
Combine lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil. Coat meat. Cover with foil, bake 30 min.
Remove foil, increase to 475°F (245°C), bake 30 more minutes until brown and crispy.

recipes.title: Lebanese Red Lentil Soup
recipes.description: A smooth, pureed red lentil soup with cumin, cayenne, cilantro, and fresh lemon.

instructions.text: Simmer lentils in stock for 20 minutes. Fry onions and garlic in olive oil.
Combine and add spices, cook 10 more minutes. Puree, add lemon and cilantro.

recipes.title: Chard Lentil Soup
recipes.description: A Lebanese-style soup with brown lentils, Swiss chard, potatoes, and a lemon-garlic finish.

instructions.text: Boil lentils 10 min, add chard 5 min, add potatoes and cook 12 min.
Add lemon-garlic-salt mixture, simmer 5 min. Add oil, heat 2 min on high.

recipes.title: Koosa (Stuffed Zucchini)
recipes.description: Lebanese stuffed zucchini filled with seasoned beef and rice, cooked in tomato sauce.

instructions.text: Hollow out zucchini. Mix meat with rice, nutmeg, pepper.
Fill zucchini leaving 1 inch space. Cover with tomatoes and soup, cook 35-45 min.

recipes.title: Lebanese Garlic Sauce II
recipes.description: A mayonnaise-like garlic sauce made with an immersion blender.

instructions.text: Combine oils, garlic, and lemon juice in a quart jar.
Blend with immersion blender until thick and mayo-like.

recipes.title: Adas bil Hamod
recipes.description: A Lebanese lentil soup with spinach, caramelized onions, and lemon.

instructions.text: Caramelize onions in oil 10-15 min. Add lentils, spinach, garlic, mint and water.
Boil then simmer 20 min. Add salt and lemon juice.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Wraps
recipes.description: Lebanese-style pita wraps with spiced sweet potatoes, lentils, broccoli, and barbecue sauce.

instructions.text: Boil sweet potatoes 8 min. Fry broccoli 5 min, add lentils, potatoes, and spices.
Add tomatoes, cook 3 min. Spread BBQ sauce on pita, fill and fold.

recipes.title: Cilantro and Garlic Potatoes
recipes.description: Crispy fried potatoes tossed with a cilantro, garlic, cumin, and lemon dressing.

instructions.text: Deep fry potatoes at 375°F (190°C) for 8 min. Drain.
Fry garlic and cilantro 5 min. Toss with potatoes, lemon, salt, and cumin.

recipes.title: Fried Cauliflower with Tahini Sauce
recipes.description: Crispy deep-fried cauliflower florets served with a creamy tahini sauce.

instructions.text: Make tahini sauce by blending tahini, water, garlic, parsley, lemon, salt, pepper.
Fry cauliflower at 375°F (190°C) for 8 min. Serve with tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Mahallebi
recipes.description: A creamy Lebanese milk pudding topped with pistachios and cinnamon syrup.

instructions.text: Mix corn flour with 1 cup milk. Heat remaining milk with sugar and vanilla.
Combine, add cream, cook until thick. Pour into containers, top with pistachios, chill.
Make syrup with water, sugar, lemon, cinnamon. Boil 5 min. Serve pudding with syrup.

recipes.title: Muhammara
recipes.description: A Lebanese walnut and pomegranate dip with warm spices - perfect with pita.

instructions.text: Add all ingredients to food processor and blend until smooth.
Serve with pita pieces.

recipes.title: Lentil Lemon Soup II
recipes.description: A hearty Lebanese lentil soup with Swiss chard, made with a homemade herb broth.

instructions.text: Make broth: simmer chicken broth, 6 cups water, herbs, bay leaf, small onion for 1.5 hrs. Strain.
Cook lentils in broth + 4 cups water for 1 hr. Fry onion and garlic in oil, add chard.
Combine chard mixture with lentils, add cilantro and lemon juice, simmer 15 min.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma
recipes.description: Marinated baked chicken served in pita with vegetables and tahini-yogurt sauce.

instructions.text: Make marinade with vinegar, 1/4 cup yogurt, oil, and spices. Coat chicken and refrigerate 4+ hours.
Make sauce with tahini, 1/4 cup yogurt, garlic, lemon, olive oil, parsley.
Bake chicken at 350°F (175°C) covered 30 min, then uncovered 5-10 min until done.
Slice chicken. Serve in pita with vegetables and tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Carnitas Burritos with Poblano-Corn Salsa
recipes.description: Tender carnitas wrapped in tortillas with fresh poblano-corn salsa.

instructions.text: Combine pork with orange juice, lime juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, and salt. Slow cook until tender.
Shred pork and crisp in a pan.
Make salsa by combining roasted poblano, corn, and cilantro.
Assemble burritos with carnitas and salsa. Roll and serve.

notes: On a grill roast the poblano pepper until it is charred, then place it in a large bowl and using plastic seal it. Do not disturb it for 15 minutes.
You can serve with pico de gallo or ranch dressing and barbecue sauce.

recipes.title: Chipotle Mexican Steak and Cilantro Lime Rice Burritos
recipes.description: Chipotle-marinated steak with fresh cilantro lime rice in flour tortillas.

instructions.text: Marinate steak with chipotle, lime juice, and garlic for at least 30 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear steak to desired doneness. Slice against the grain.
Mix cooked rice with cilantro and lime juice.
Assemble burritos with steak, rice, beans, and sour cream.

notes: Work the steaks to absorb the marinade before placing them in the fridge for half an hour.

recipes.title: Chorizo, Potato and Queso Burritos
recipes.description: Hearty breakfast-style burritos with spicy chorizo, crispy potatoes, and melted queso.

instructions.text: Cook chorizo in a skillet, breaking up into crumbles. Remove and set aside.
Fry diced potatoes in chorizo drippings until crispy and golden.
Scramble eggs and combine with chorizo and potatoes.
Warm tortillas, fill with mixture, top with queso and salsa. Roll up.

recipes.title: Crispy Black Bean Quinoa Burritos
recipes.description: Healthy vegetarian burritos with protein-rich quinoa and black beans, pan-fried for extra crunch.

instructions.text: Mix cooked quinoa with black beans, corn, cumin, and chili powder.
Fill tortillas with mixture and cheese. Roll tightly.
Pan-fry seam-side down until golden and crispy on all sides.
Serve with salsa.

notes: The crispy black bean quinoa burrito is one of my favorite burritos, I take it as my lunch or even as my supper.
It is very easy to prepare and if you want to have a burrito for lunch or supper, I would recommend this.
Serve with creamy avocado yogurt dip.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Burritos
recipes.description: Easy slow cooker pulled pork burritos - set it and forget it.

instructions.text: Place pork in slow cooker with salsa verde, cumin, and garlic powder.
Cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours until fork tender.
Shred pork with two forks.
Assemble burritos with pork, beans, cheese, and sour cream.

notes: There are many types of burritos you can make from pork; this is one of my favorites.
It is also very easy to prepare and I am sure everybody in the family will appreciate it.
You can heat the tortillas using the microwave or a pan.
You can serve as it is or add a little amount of cheese on top and place it in a broiler for 5 seconds.

recipes.title: Crispy Beef Burritos with Poblano Queso
recipes.description: Pan-fried beef burritos smothered in creamy poblano queso sauce.

instructions.text: Brown ground beef with taco seasoning.
Fill tortillas with beef and beans. Roll and pan-fry until crispy.
Make queso: blend roasted poblanos, cream cheese, milk, and Jack cheese. Heat until smooth.
Top burritos with poblano queso sauce.

notes: Everybody in the family is sure to love this - seasoned beef with black beans and poblano pepper, cheese and corn all under a delicious tortilla.

recipes.title: Over-Stuffed Frito Burritos
recipes.description: Loaded burritos with seasoned beef, Fritos, and all the fixings.

instructions.text: Cook ground beef with taco seasoning.
Warm tortillas and layer with beef, cheese, Fritos, lettuce, and sour cream.
Roll tightly and serve immediately while Fritos are crunchy.

notes: It is one of the tastiest burritos ever.
You can serve with pico de gallo or ranch dressing and barbecue sauce.

recipes.title: Chipotle Shrimp Burritos with Simple Avocado Cream
recipes.description: Spicy chipotle shrimp burritos topped with cool avocado cream.

instructions.text: Toss shrimp with chipotle and lime. Sauté until pink.
Make avocado cream by blending avocado, sour cream, and cilantro.
Fill tortillas with rice and shrimp. Roll up.
Top with avocado cream.

notes: Put the shrimp in a gallon freezer pouch, together with the mixture. Marinate it and place the bag in the fridge for 2 hours.
Place this mixture in the fridge for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Burrito Smothered in Avocado Salsa Verde
recipes.description: Roasted sweet potato burritos with a creamy avocado salsa verde sauce.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Toss sweet potatoes with oil, paprika, cumin, cayenne, salt and pepper.
Roast on baking sheet for 45 minutes, flipping at 20 minutes, until golden.
Make avocado salsa verde: blend avocados, salsa verde, jalapeño, garlic, lime juice, cilantro. Season with salt.
Assemble burritos with roasted sweet potatoes, black beans, peppers, cheese. Bake 5 minutes to melt.
Top with avocado sauce, lettuce, onion, and jalapeño.

notes: Sounds very complicated, well it's not - very easy to prepare and the ingredients are easily available.
Toppings to use: 1 1/2 cups chopped romaine lettuce, 1 small red onion finely chopped, finely chopped jalapeño (optional), sour cream (optional).

recipes.title: Black Bean and Butternut Squash Burritos
recipes.description: Vegan-friendly burritos with roasted butternut squash, black beans, and Daiya cheese.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Roast butternut squash with oil, salt, pepper for 45 minutes.
Cook rice according to package. Sauté onion and garlic in oil for 5 minutes.
Add red pepper, black beans, rice, cumin, cayenne. Cook 9 minutes.
Add roasted squash and Daiya cheese. Fill tortillas and serve warm.

notes: You can use the stove or microwave for heating garlic.
You are allowed to use water but only in small amounts.
Toppings of choice: avocado, salsa, vegan sour cream, spinach/lettuce, cilantro, etc.

recipes.title: Chicken Burritos with Poblano Sauce
recipes.description: Baked chicken burritos topped with creamy sour cream-poblano sauce.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cook onion 5 minutes, add chicken until browned.
Add garlic, tomato paste, beans, broth, and all spices. Simmer until liquid absorbed.
Fill tortillas with chicken mixture and cheese. Roll and bake seam-down 20 minutes.
Make sauce: char poblanos over flame, peel and chop. Make roux with butter and flour, add broth and poblanos.
Stir in sour cream, season. Pour over baked burritos.

notes: The sour cream-poblano sauce is spicy and cool at the same time and it's a genius sauce since it reheats perfectly for leftovers.
These burritos reheat like champs.
You can bake all of them then reheat leftovers quickly in the microwave and throw them in the oven to crisp up the tortillas.
The recipe yields 4-5 large burritos.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burrito Omelet
recipes.description: A creative fusion - an omelet wrapped in a warm tortilla for a quick breakfast burrito.

instructions.text: Crack eggs in bowl, add water, salt, pepper, and herbs. Mix well.
Heat tortilla in a pan for 10 seconds per side. Set aside and keep warm.
Melt butter in pan, pour egg mixture, cook on low. Pull edges to let uncooked egg flow to sides.
When set, add desired fillings. Slide omelet onto warm tortilla.
Fold tortilla from sides to seal. Cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Simple Kale and Black Bean Burritos
recipes.description: Quick vegetarian burritos with massaged kale and seasoned black beans.

instructions.text: Mix lime juice, olive oil, cumin, chili powder, salt, jalapeño, cilantro, and kale. Massage to marinate.
Warm beans with garlic in a pot with a little water. Mash slightly with fork.
Warm tortilla. Layer with beans, kale mixture, avocado, onion, and feta.
Roll up, folding sides in. Cut in half and serve with sour cream.

notes: You can use the stove or microwave for warming beans.
You can also use a small saucepan but this depends on the number of burritos you want to make.

recipes.title: Burrito de la Calle
recipes.description: Street-style steak burritos with fresh pico de gallo salsa.

instructions.text: Make marinade by mixing oil, lime juice, jalapeño, garlic, salt, pepper. Marinate meat 1-2 hours.
Make salsa by combining tomatoes, onion, cilantro, lime juice, Serranos, salt, pepper.
Grill meat at 450-550°F for 8-9 minutes. Rest and slice.
Assemble burritos: 3/4 cup beans, 1/2 cup meat, 1/3 cup salsa per tortilla. Roll and serve.

notes: 2 steaks of your choice (I like New York strips).

recipes.title: Pork Belly Burrito
recipes.description: Tender slow-roasted pork belly with cilantro lime rice in a flour tortilla.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 275°F. Mix marinade: garlic, soy sauce, Sriracha, brown sugar, vinegar, salt, pepper.
Coat pork belly in marinade, bake 1 hour. Increase to 300°F, stir, bake 1 more hour.
Prepare rice and mix with cilantro and lime juice.
Warm tortillas and beans. Layer beans, rice, pork belly, salsa. Roll and serve.

recipes.title: Mission-Style Burrito
recipes.description: Classic San Francisco Mission-style burrito with all the fixings.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Wrap tortillas in foil to warm.
Heat onions in oil until translucent. Add beans and stir.
Remove warm tortillas. Layer beans, cheese, steak, guacamole, salsa, sour cream in center.
Fold one half over filling, then fold the other side over. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Kale and Feta Burrito
recipes.description: A healthy vegetarian burrito with sautéed kale, pinto beans, brown rice, and tangy feta.

instructions.text: Heat beans in a small saucepan with salt and a little water.
Sauté onion in oil until browned (6-7 minutes). Add kale and cook until wilted. Season with cayenne.
Steam tortillas lightly. Fill with rice, kale mixture, beans, and feta.
Roll up and seal.

notes: You may think that making a burrito from vegetables is hard. Well I'm not only here to tell you that it's easy but I will also show you how.

recipes.title: Blueberry Coconut Muffins
recipes.description: Light and fluffy muffins with fresh blueberries and shredded coconut.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. In a medium bowl, mix flour, sugars, and baking powder.
In another bowl, lightly mix milk and yogurt.
Add egg, oil, and vanilla to wet mixture. Be careful not to over mix.
Make a well in dry mixture and add wet mixture. Gently fold together.
Add blueberries and coconut to dough and combine until just blended.
Fill greased and floured muffin tins about 3/4 full. Bake for 20 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Raspberry Lemon Muffins
recipes.description: Tangy lemon muffins studded with fresh raspberries and vanilla pudding for extra moisture.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line muffin tins with paper liners.
In a medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and pudding.
Lightly whisk eggs in another bowl. Add buttermilk, vanilla, and oil. Zest lemons and set aside. Juice lemons and add to wet mixture.
Combine wet and dry mixtures, fold together being careful not to over mix. Add lemon zest and fold in raspberries.
Fill muffin tins about 3/4 full and bake for about 20 minutes or until done in the middle.

recipes.title: Traditional Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: Classic buttermilk blueberry muffins with optional walnuts.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Grease muffin tins with shortening.
Combine flour, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in a bowl.
In another bowl, combine sugar with egg and vanilla. Once butter is cooled, add to sugar mixture. Add buttermilk.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and just combine.
Batter will be slightly lumpy. Fold in blueberries and walnuts.
Spoon batter into prepared muffin tins and bake until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean, about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Breakfast Muffins
recipes.description: Hearty whole wheat muffins with mashed bananas, oats, and pecans.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Prepare muffin tins by greasing with shortening or filling with muffin papers.
In a large bowl, combine flour, salt, baking powder, and baking soda. Set aside.
In a medium bowl, combine sugars with egg and oil. Add yogurt and bananas to wet mixture.
Combine wet ingredients with dry ingredients until just mixed. Overworking the batter will cause the batter to be too hard.
Add oats and pecans. Spoon batter into muffin tins.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until toothpick comes out of the center clean.

recipes.title: Morning Start Blueberry Oatmeal Muffins
recipes.description: Wholesome breakfast muffins with blueberries, oats, and pecans.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. In one bowl, combine flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
In another bowl, combine sugar, egg, and vanilla. Add yogurt and milk to wet ingredients.
Combine wet ingredients with dry and fold in blueberries, oats, and pecans until just mixed.
Fill muffin tins with batter until about 3/4 from the top.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until done in the middle and golden brown on the top.

recipes.title: Tea Time Mini Muffins
recipes.description: Adorable mini muffins topped with fresh berries, perfect for tea parties.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a small bowl, lightly whisk egg with buttermilk. Add cooled butter to mixture.
In a medium bowl, combine flour, white sugar, baking powder, and salt. Fold in wet ingredients until just mixed.
Grease a mini sized muffin tin. Using a small cookie scoop, spoon batter into muffin cups. Top each cup with various berries.
Bake for approximately 10-15 minutes, depending on size. Cool and serve for tea party or as appetizers.

recipes.title: Chai Spiced Muffins
recipes.description: Warmly spiced muffins with cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, and allspice - perfect for cozy days.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a large bowl, combine flour, sugars, baking powder, salt, and spices.
In another bowl, lightly whisk egg, vanilla, milk, and oil. Combine all ingredients together and lightly mix.
Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
These muffins are perfect for cozy days at home with something warm to drink!

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Banana Muffins
recipes.description: Decadent banana muffins loaded with chocolate pudding and chocolate chips.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease muffin tins with shortening or use muffin papers. Set aside.
Place bananas in a small microwave safe bowl and microwave for about 2 minutes to help release juices. Don't be afraid to use black or bruised bananas! Mash with a fork and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, and pudding mix.
When bananas are cooled, add egg, butter, and sugar. Gradually add milk and vanilla. Combine well with flour mixture, adding chocolate chips while you gently mix.
Spoon batter into prepared muffin tins and bake for about 20 minutes. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Raspberry Date Night Muffins
recipes.description: Romantic chocolate muffins with almond extract, lemon zest, chocolate chips, and fresh raspberries.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Prepare muffin tins by lining with paper cups or greasing with shortening.
In a large bowl, combine flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, and chocolate pudding mix.
In a small bowl, lightly whisk egg with sugar, buttermilk, almond and vanilla extract. Add cooled butter.
Zest one lemon and add to butter mixture. Create a well in dry ingredients and combine wet and dry. Add chocolate chips and raspberries.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until done in the middle.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spiced Muffins
recipes.description: Fall-inspired muffins with canned pumpkin, applesauce, and cinnamon sugar topping.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Prepare muffin tins with paper cups or grease with shortening.
In a small bowl, combine canned pumpkin with applesauce and oil. In another bowl, combine egg with milk.
In a large bowl, mix dry ingredients: flour, baking powder, salt, and pumpkin pie spice.
Add egg mixture and pumpkin mixture to dry ingredients. Lightly stir until just combined.
Using a cookie scoop, fill muffin tins until about 3/4 from top. Sprinkle cinnamon sugar on top of each muffin.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Chocolate Lovers Muffins
recipes.description: Triple chocolate muffins with cocoa, chocolate pudding, and chocolate chips.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Prepare muffin tins by greasing with shortening.
In a small bowl, combine chocolate pudding with buttermilk, egg, and vanilla.
Add cooled butter and sugar. In another bowl, combine dry ingredients: flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Fold in wet ingredients and stir to combine. Add chocolate chips.
Scoop batter into muffin tins and bake for 20-25 minutes.

recipes.title: Healthy Bran Apple Muffins
recipes.description: Wholesome whole wheat muffins with wheat bran, Granny Smith apples, and pecans.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Prepare muffin tins by greasing with cooking spray or use muffin papers.
Chop 1/2 cup pecans and set aside. Reserve the other half cup as whole pecans.
In a large bowl, combine flour, bran, salt, and baking powder.
In another bowl, combine egg, brown sugar, and applesauce. Add milk, yogurt, and oil.
Combine egg mixture with flour mixture. Add chopped apples and 1/2 cup chopped pecans. Combine well.
Spoon batter into muffin cups and top each with a whole pecan. Bake for 20-25 minutes. Serve warm with honey or honey butter.

recipes.title: Honey Bran Muffins
recipes.description: Naturally sweetened bran muffins with honey and raisins.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Combine flour, bran, salt, baking powder, and brown sugar in a large bowl.
Combine honey and butter together with a fork.
When smooth, add buttermilk and eggs. Bring flour mixture and honey mixture together and stir till just combined.
Add raisins and combine.
Spoon batter into greased muffin tins. Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peppermint Brownie Muffins
recipes.description: Brownie-style muffins with peppermint extract and crushed candy canes - perfect for the holidays.

ingredients.item: mini chocolate chips or chocolate shavings

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line muffin tins with paper muffin cups.
In a medium bowl, combine brownie mix, eggs, water, and oil. Add peppermint extract and semi sweet chocolate chips.
Spoon batter into muffin tins and top each muffin with a sprinkling of crushed candy canes and either mini chocolate chips or chocolate shavings.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Cranberry Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: Fruity muffins loaded with fresh blueberries and dried cranberries.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
In another bowl, combine vanilla, buttermilk, egg, and cooled butter. Bring together with a fork.
Add buttermilk mixture to flour mixture and stir to just combine.
Fold in blueberries and cranberries. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins.
Bake for about 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Lemon Cake Muffins
recipes.description: Light and fluffy lemon muffins topped with whipped cream and fresh lemon wedges.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line muffin tins with muffin papers.
In a large bowl, combine sifted cake flour with sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, combine vanilla, buttermilk, and oil. When mixed, add pudding.
Zest and juice three lemons. Set aside fourth lemon. Add lemon juice to wet mixture and zest to dry mixture.
Using a third bowl, alternate combining wet and dry ingredients, giving a quick mix after each addition.
Spoon batter into prepared muffin tins and bake for about 20-25 minutes or until done in the middle. Cool completely.
While muffins are cooling, slice remaining lemon into small triangles. When muffins have cooled, add a spoonful of whip cream and top with one lemon wedge. Serve.

recipes.title: Pomegranate Blueberry Energy Muffins
recipes.description: Antioxidant-packed muffins with blueberries, pomegranate seeds, and dark chocolate chips.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Slice into pomegranate and gut out 1/2 cup seeds; set aside.
In a large bowl, combine flour, cinnamon, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
In a small bowl, combine sugar with cooled butter, egg, and buttermilk. Gently combine buttermilk mixture with flour mixture.
Fold in blueberries, pomegranate seeds, and dark chocolate chips. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins.
Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until done in the middle. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Autumn Time Muffins
recipes.description: Fall-flavored muffins with pumpkin, molasses, and pomegranate seeds.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Slice into a pomegranate and remove seeds; set aside 1/2 cup.
In a large bowl, combine flours, baking soda, baking powder, pumpkin pie spice, and salt.
In a medium bowl, combine melted butter with molasses until smooth. Add vegetable oil, eggs, and buttermilk. Gradually add pumpkin and stir till combined.
Make a well in the middle of dry ingredients and add pumpkin mixture. Stir about 8-10 times; don't overwork.
Toss in pomegranate seeds and combine. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins. Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mint Muffins
recipes.description: Rich chocolate muffins with peppermint extract and two kinds of chocolate chips.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. In a large bowl, combine sifted cake flour with baking powder, salt, and cocoa.
In another bowl, combine sugar, eggs, cooled butter, peppermint extract, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add milk to butter mixture.
Combine wet ingredients with dry ingredients; don't over mix. Toss in chocolate chips and mint chocolate chips and combine.
Spoon batter into greased or paper lined muffin tins, until just from the top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Vanilla Buttermilk Muffins
recipes.description: Light and fluffy vanilla muffins made extra moist with yogurt and pudding.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a large bowl, combine sifted cake flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, combine egg, vanilla, buttermilk, and oil. In a small bowl, combine vanilla pudding and vanilla yogurt.
Add yogurt mixture with other wet ingredients and combine all ingredients together.
Spoon batter into greased or paper lined muffin tins. Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until done in the center. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Holiday Gingerbread Pumpkin Muffins
recipes.description: Festive muffins combining gingerbread spices with pumpkin and molasses.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a large bowl, combine flour, brown sugar, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, ginger, and allspice.
In another bowl, combine eggs, oil, applesauce, milk, vanilla, and molasses.
Once mixed, add pumpkin. Combine wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just mixed.
Scoop batter in greased or paper lined muffin tins. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until center comes out clean when toothpick is inserted.

recipes.title: Peter Rabbit Carrot Cake Muffins
recipes.description: Carrot cake-inspired muffins with shredded carrots, raisins, and toasted pecans.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Spread pecans out on a cookie sheet and bake for 5-8 minutes or until lightly toasted. Set aside.
In a large bowl, bring together flour, sugar, and salt.
In another bowl, combine egg, vanilla, milk, applesauce, and oil until just combined.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients. Add carrots, raisins, and pecans, being careful not to over mix.
Bake in greased or paper lined muffin tins for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Mid-Day Pick-Me-Up Muffins
recipes.description: Energizing muffins with pumpkin, chocolate chips, blueberries, and an oat crumb topping.

ingredients.prep_note: soft and cubed, for crumb topping

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease or line muffin tins; set aside.
In a small bowl, combine all of the crumb toppings; set aside.
In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, and cinnamon.
In a medium bowl, whisk together egg, milk, vanilla, and pumpkin. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and lightly mix.
Add chocolate chips and fold in blueberries.
Scoop batter into prepared muffin tins. Top each muffin with a tablespoon of crumb topping. Bake for 20-25 minutes. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Muffins
recipes.description: Apple muffins with gooey caramel pieces, cinnamon, and nutmeg.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Prepare muffin tins by lining with paper muffin cups.
Peel and cube apples; set aside. Chop up caramel squares and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
In a medium bowl, combine sugar, butter, egg, milk, and vanilla.
Gently combine wet ingredients into dry ingredients, adding apples and caramels while mixing.
Scoop batter into prepared muffin tins and bake for 20-25 minutes or until batter is cooked in the middle and caramels are oozing out!

recipes.title: Chocolate Hazelnut Muffins
recipes.description: Rich chocolate muffins with toasted hazelnuts and chocolate chips.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease muffin tins and set aside.
Spread out hazelnuts on a cookie sheet and toast in preheated oven for 5-8 minutes or until lightly brown; set aside.
In a large bowl, combine sifted cake flour, baking powder, baking soda, cocoa, and salt.
In a medium bowl, combine egg, buttermilk, cooled butter, and vanilla. Combine milk mixture with flour mixture until just held together.
Fold in chocolate chips and hazelnuts; don't over mix. Spoon batter into prepared muffin tins and bake for about 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Blackberry Chocolate Muffins with Crumb Topping
recipes.description: Chocolate muffins with fresh blackberries and a delicious oat crumb topping.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a medium bowl, combine all of the crumb toppings and set aside. Prepare muffin tins by lining with paper muffin cups.
In a large bowl combine the flour, baking powder, cocoa and salt. In a medium bowl combine the egg, sugar, vanilla and milk. Add the vanilla and milk and lightly whisk together.
Mix the wet ingredients with the dry and fold in chocolate chips, blackberries and lemon zest.
Spoon batter into muffin tins and top each muffin with one tablespoon of crumb mixture.
Bake for 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean. Cool and serve.

notes: Crumb Topping: 3/4 cup flour, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 3/4 cup oats, 1 tsp cinnamon, 3/4 cup melted butter

recipes.title: Mocha Muffins
recipes.description: Rich chocolate muffins with coffee flavor.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the flour, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
In another bowl whisk the eggs into the sugar, vanilla, butter (cooled) and buttermilk. Gradually whisk in the cooled coffee.
Combine the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and fold in the chocolate chips.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: These taste great warm, so pop any leftovers into the microwave before serving.

recipes.title: Triple Threat Berry Muffins
recipes.description: Delicious muffins loaded with raspberries, blueberries, and blackberries.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
In a medium bowl combine the sugar, egg, butter (cooled), and buttermilk. Lightly whisk together and combine the wet ingredients with the dry ingredients.
Gently fold in the berries and orange zest.
Spoon batter into greased muffin tins.
Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Ginger Lemon Muffins
recipes.description: A great muffin to go with your morning coffee.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
Combine the sugar, lemon zest and ginger in a food processor and pulse until well combined.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk and butter. Add in the ginger and lemon zest mixture and mix well.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Add half a cup of your favorite nuts to the batter before baking.

recipes.title: Cinnamon and Spice Muffins
recipes.description: These spiced muffins are great for breakfast, teatime or just a snack on the go.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar, spices and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter and vanilla.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Add half a cup of your favorite nuts to the batter before baking.

recipes.title: Apple Cranberry Muffins
recipes.description: This delicious and easy to follow recipe is sure to become a firm family favourite.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter and vanilla.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Fold in the apple and cranberries. Do not over mix.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Add half a cup of raisins to the batter before baking if desired.

recipes.title: Cherry Chocolate Muffins
recipes.description: A deliciously decadent breakfast time, snack time or anytime treat!

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, cocoa, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk and butter.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Fold in the cherries and chocolate chips. Do not over mix.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Serve warm topped with whipped cream for a delicious dessert.

recipes.title: Candy Cane Muffins
recipes.description: These candy cane muffins make a great Christmas morning treat.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter and peppermint extract.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead. Sprinkle the tops with the crushed candy canes.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Add 1/4 cup of cocoa to the batter for chocolate muffins.

recipes.title: Nutella Muffins
recipes.description: Deliciously moist to the last bite, these muffins are sure to disappear quickly.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter and Nutella.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Maple Bacon Muffins
recipes.description: These savory muffins are great served warm for breakfast or even a snack.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter and maple syrup.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Fold in the bacon. Do not over mix.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: For a complete breakfast serve with a side of eggs.

recipes.title: Eggnog Muffins
recipes.description: These lightly spiced eggnog muffins are a great holiday treat.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar, spices and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter, eggnog and vanilla.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: These muffins freeze well, just pop in the microwave for a couple minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Coconut Muffins
recipes.description: Definitely for coconut lovers - this light, moist muffin is sure to be a crowd pleaser.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter and vanilla. Mix in the coconut.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Drizzle with chocolate syrup for an added sweet treat.

recipes.title: Peach Muffins
recipes.description: Bursting with plump peaches, these muffins are sure to be hit!

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter and vanilla.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Fold in the peaches. Do not over mix.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: The peaches can be replaced with any of your favorite fruit.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Muffins
recipes.description: These scrumptious muffins are sure to get rave reviews.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter, poppy seeds and vanilla.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Make a quick glaze for your muffins by mixing together a cup of powdered sugar with a couple tablespoons of orange juice.

recipes.title: Orange Cinnamon Muffins
recipes.description: These muffins are packed full of citrus cinnamon goodness.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar, cinnamon and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter, orange zest and vanilla.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Make a quick glaze by mixing two tablespoons of orange juice with a cup of powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Muffins
recipes.description: Moist to the last bite, these make an indulgent teatime snack.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter, peanut butter, bananas and vanilla.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Add a teaspoon of cinnamon to the batter to spice it up a bit.

recipes.title: Cheesy Corn Muffins
recipes.description: These savory muffins are so filling they could be a light meal on its own.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, cornmeal, cheese, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk and butter.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Add half a cup of crumbled bacon to the batter to make an even heartier muffin.

recipes.title: Amaretto Muffins
recipes.description: These light and moist muffins are so quick and easy to prepare.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter and Amaretto. Mix in the almonds.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Add half a cup of chocolate chips to the batter.

recipes.title: Lemon Raspberry Almond Muffins
recipes.description: These muffins have a lovely tart flavor from the pairing of lemon and raspberry.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter, lemon zest and almond extract.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Fold in the raspberries and almonds. Do not over mix.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Replace the raspberry with poppy seeds for lemon poppy muffins.

recipes.title: Apple White Chocolate Muffins
recipes.description: In this divine muffin recipe, the classic pairing of apple and cinnamon are enhanced by white chocolate.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar, cinnamon and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter and vanilla.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Fold in the apple and white chocolate chips. Do not over mix.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Serve warm, topped with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Chocolate Hazelnut Muffins
recipes.description: These muffins are the perfect sweet treat on the go!

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, cocoa, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk and butter.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Fold in the hazelnuts and chocolate chips. Do not over mix.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: To serve for dessert, warm slightly and drizzle with chocolate syrup.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter and Jelly Muffins
recipes.description: A childhood favorite in a ready to go muffin; kids will love these.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter and peanut butter.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Do not beat the mixture.
Distribute half the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead. Next drop a teaspoon of jam into each cup and cover with the remaining batter.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: These freeze well and make a great quick breakfast or snack, just pop in the microwave for a minute.

recipes.title: Bacon Cheese Muffins
recipes.description: These delightful muffins are a perfect addition to any breakfast table.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk and butter. Mix in the cheese.
Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Fold in the bacon. Do not over mix.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: For a different texture and flavor, substitute cornmeal for half the flour.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.description: Classic buttermilk pancakes.

instructions.text: Preheat a non-stick griddle to 400°F.
Mix all ingredients together to make batter.
Pour on hot griddle in small circular amounts. When pancakes start lightly bubbling, they are ready to flip.
Serve hot with warmed syrup, butter, jam or peanut butter.

recipes.title: Blueberry Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy pancakes loaded with fresh blueberries.

instructions.text: Preheat a griddle to high.
Mix all ingredients to make the batter.
Cook on hot griddle. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Whole Grain Pancakes with Blueberry Sauce
recipes.description: Healthy whole grain pancakes served with homemade blueberry sauce.

instructions.text: Preheat a lightly greased pancake griddle or a large skillet.
Mix all pancake ingredients together. Cook on the hot griddle.
Combine the sauce ingredients in a medium pan; cook over medium high heat, stirring frequently.
Sauce should gradually thicken. Serve hot over pancakes.

recipes.title: Buckwheat Pancakes
recipes.description: Hearty buckwheat pancakes with a nutty flavor.

instructions.text: Mix all ingredients together with a whisk.
Cook on a preheated lightly greased griddle or skillet.
Flip when bubbles begin to form on one side.
Serve hot with butter and warmed maple syrup.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy pancakes studded with mini chocolate chips.

instructions.text: Heat a griddle or a large skillet to medium high; lightly grease.
Combine the flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, eggs, oil and buttermilk.
Whisk until well combined. Cook pancakes on hot griddle. Before flipping, sprinkle on a few chocolate chips.
Flip the pancakes when bubbles start to form, about 1 minute.
Serve pancakes hot with butter, warmed syrup and a sprinkling of powdered sugar.

recipes.title: German Pancakes
recipes.description: Oven-baked puffy pancakes with lemon and powdered sugar.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Place shortening in a large cast iron skillet and place in oven for about 7 minutes.
In a medium bowl, combine the flour, salt and sugar.
In another bowl, bring together the butter, eggs, milk and vanilla. Add the juice and zest of one lemon.
Place batter in greased skillet and bake for about 20-25 minutes, until the pancake puffs up.
Remove from oven and loosen the pancake with a spatula.
Place the pancake on a large plate. Dust with powdered sugar, lemon juice and lemon zest. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Lemon Blueberry Pancakes
recipes.description: Tangy lemon pancakes with fresh blueberries.

instructions.text: Preheat a pancake griddle.
Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Cook on the preheated griddle.
Serve hot with butter and warmed syrup.

recipes.title: Silver Dollars
recipes.description: Mini buttermilk pancakes perfect for kids.

instructions.text: Preheat a pancake griddle to high. Spray lightly with cooking spray.
Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, drop batter onto griddle. Cook until batter begins to bubble and then flip to cook on the other side.
Serve immediately with soft butter and warmed syrup.

recipes.title: Two Berry Pancakes
recipes.description: Blueberry pancakes topped with homemade strawberry sauce.

instructions.text: Preheat a pancake griddle or a large cast iron pan.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, 2 tablespoons of sugar and the salt.
Add the eggs, buttermilk, vanilla and butter.
Fold in the blueberries.
Grill on the preheated griddle.
In a small saucepan, bring to a boil the remaining ingredients until the mixture thickens.
Drizzle the strawberry sauce over the blueberry pancakes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Spice Cakes
recipes.description: Spiced pancakes with cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves.

instructions.text: Preheat a pancake griddle.
Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Whisk together until well combined. Cook pancakes and serve hot with butter, warmed syrup and a sprinkle of powdered sugar if desired.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy pumpkin spiced pancakes perfect for fall.

instructions.text: Preheat a griddle to high.
Combine all ingredients and whisk together.
Cook pancakes and serve hot with warmed maple syrup and butter.

recipes.title: Banana Sour Cream Pancakes
recipes.description: Moist pancakes with mashed bananas and sour cream.

instructions.text: Preheat a greased griddle to high.
Combine all ingredients, whisking to combine.
Cook pancakes, about 2 minutes on each side.
Serve hot with warmed syrup, butter, jam or peanut butter.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Chocolate Pancakes
recipes.description: Chocolate pancakes with cinnamon and mini chocolate chips.

instructions.text: Combine all ingredients and cook on a preheated greased griddle.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Toasted Pecan Blueberry Pancakes
