Arrange on a baking sheet and broil until cheese melts, about 2 to 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

notes: Use white bread with crusts trimmed, if ciabatta is not available.
recipes.source_note: Reference cookbook - Book Four: Other Recipes

recipes.title: Hungarian Sausage Breakfast Wraps
recipes.description: Tortilla wraps filled with Hungarian sausage, scrambled eggs, and cheese.

instructions.text: Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir-fry sausage until slightly browned, about 3 to 5 minutes.
Add onion and sauté for 2 minutes until soft. Add green pepper and stir fry for 1 minute.
Pour in beaten eggs and season to taste. Gently stir until egg is set. Remove from heat.
Spread sour cream on warmed tortillas. Spoon sausage-egg filling over sour cream and sprinkle with grated cheese.
Fold lower portion and sides of tortilla over filling and roll. Serve immediately.

notes: Substitute Hungarian sausage with your own choice of meat or cold cuts. Replace sour cream with mayonnaise. Add cayenne pepper to filling mixture for a spicy version.
recipes.source_note: Reference cookbook - Book Four: Other Recipes

recipes.title: Pita Breakfast Pizza
recipes.description: Quick tortilla pizzas topped with spaghetti sauce, bacon, pineapple, and mozzarella.

instructions.text: Spread spaghetti sauce over each tortilla.
Divide bacon and pineapple equally among the tortillas.
Sprinkle with mozzarella and bake in a pre-heated 375°F oven for 10 minutes or until cheese melts.
Serve hot or warm.

notes: Replace spaghetti sauce with sour cream and top with fruit and grated cheddar cheese.
recipes.source_note: Reference cookbook - Book Four: Other Recipes

recipes.title: Salmon and Rocket Sandwich
recipes.description: A delicious sandwich with smoked salmon, crispy bacon, cream cheese and fresh rocket on toasted ciabatta.

instructions.text: Slice ciabatta lengthwise and toast until crisp.
Arrange smoked salmon slices on the base of bread and spread with cream cheese.
Top with bacon.
Season with freshly ground black or cayenne pepper.
Arrange rocket leaves over bacon and cover with other half of ciabatta.
Cut crosswise and serve immediately.

notes: Replace salmon and bacon with your choice of cold cuts, replace rocket with other salad greens.

recipes.title: Spicy Breakfast Migas
recipes.description: A Tex-Mex breakfast dish with crispy tortilla strips, scrambled eggs, peppers, and cheese.

instructions.text: Fry flour tortillas in oil over high heat until golden and crispy, about 2 to 3 minutes. Drain on paper towels and cut into cubes. If tortillas crumble, that's fine. Save the crumbs as well. Set aside.
Whisk together eggs and half and half with seasonings as desired. Set aside.
Heat canola oil in large pan over medium heat. Sauté red onion until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Add red and green peppers and continue sautéing. Add tomatoes, and stir until tender but not soggy. Add jalapeño and stir a little.
Reduce heat to low and gradually pour in beaten egg mixture. Gently fold eggs into sautéed vegetables until set but not dry.
Sprinkle with cheese and cilantro and cook for another minute. Transfer to a serving plate. Serve warm.

notes: Omit jalapeño, if desired. Use other herbs you prefer.

recipes.title: Southern Grits
recipes.description: Classic Southern cheese grits with butter and cheddar cheese.

instructions.text: Pour water and salt in a pan. Place over medium heat and boil.
Gradually stir in grits and cook for 1 minute with constant stirring.
Reduce heat to low when mixture starts to boil. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring frequently.
Remove from heat. Stir in pepper, butter and cheese until melted.

notes: Grits can be served with bacon or sausage, eggs, biscuits or toast.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Frittata
recipes.description: A filling frittata recipe that can be made for breakfast, lunch or dinner.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven broiler.
Heat the olive oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Add the hash brown potatoes to the skillet and cook for 10 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the salt, pepper and garlic powder and pour into the skillet over the hash browns. Layer the spinach over the egg mixture.
Sprinkle the cheese evenly over the top and place under the broiler until the cheese is melted and the eggs are lightly browned.
Cut into wedges and serve immediately.

notes: Serve with a green salad for a light lunch or dinner.

recipes.title: Bacon and Tomato Frittata
recipes.description: A satisfying, hearty breakfast that is quick and easy to prepare.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven broiler.
Heat the olive oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Beat the eggs with the salt, pepper and garlic powder. Mix in the bacon and scallions and pour into the skillet. Layer with the tomato slices.
Sprinkle the cheese evenly over the top and place under the broiler until the cheese is melted and the eggs are lightly browned.
Cut into wedges and serve immediately.

notes: Sprinkle with chopped parsley to serve.

recipes.title: Broccoli and Cheese Frittata
recipes.description: An easy to follow frittata recipe that is sure to be a crowd pleaser.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven broiler.
Heat the olive oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium heat. Add the broccoli and cook for 2 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the salt, pepper, garlic powder and scallions and pour over the broccoli.
Sprinkle the cheese evenly over the top and place under the broiler until the cheese is melted and the eggs are lightly browned.
Cut into wedges and serve immediately.

notes: Store leftovers in the fridge and reheat in the microwave before serving.

recipes.title: Cherry Chocolate Scones
recipes.description: These scones make a tasty breakfast treat.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Grease a baking sheet and set aside.
Sift the flour and salt together in a large bowl. Rub in the butter. Mix in the chocolate and cherries.
Add the sugar, then milk and egg and combine to get a soft dough.
Knead the dough briefly on a lightly floured surface then roll out into a 1/2-inch thick round.
Divide and cut into 8 wedges, and place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

notes: If preferred, white chocolate chips can be used instead of the semi-sweet chocolate.

recipes.title: Apricot Scones
recipes.description: A delicious treat to go with your morning coffee.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Grease a baking sheet and set aside.
Sift the flour, cinnamon and salt together in a large bowl. Rub in the butter. Mix in the apricots.
Add the sugar, then milk and egg and combine to get a soft dough.
Knead the dough briefly on a lightly floured surface then roll out into a 1/2-inch thick round.
Divide and cut into 8 wedges, and place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.

notes: Store leftovers in an airtight container for up to three days.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Oat Scones
recipes.description: A delicious lightly spiced scone. Serve for breakfast or as a teatime treat.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Grease a baking sheet and set aside.
Mix the flours, oats, cinnamon and salt together in a large bowl. Rub in the butter.
Add the sugar, then milk, egg and maple syrup and combine to get a soft dough.
Knead the dough briefly on a lightly floured surface then roll out into a 1/2-inch thick round.
Divide and cut into 8 wedges, and place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Scones
recipes.description: Pumpkin and chocolate pair beautifully together in this delicious scone.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Whisk together the flour, sugar, spices, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Blend the butter into the flour mixture slowly, using two knives or working with your fingers, until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Set aside.
In another bowl, combine the buttermilk, pumpkin puree, chocolate chips and vanilla and mix well. Add this to the dry ingredients and mix till dough is formed.
On a floured surface, gently knead the dough five or six times and pat into a circle that is about one and a half inches thick and seven inches wide.
Cut this circle into quarters, and then each quarter in half so you have eight scones. Beat the egg and milk together and brush over the tops of the scones.
Bake for 15 minutes or until an inserted toothpick comes out clean.
Transfer to a wire rack and cool.

notes: Drizzle with chocolate syrup before serving.

recipes.title: Apple Cheddar Muffins
recipes.description: Cheddar and apple go well together in this tasty breakfast muffin.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk and butter. Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Fold in the apple and cheese. Do not over mix.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Serve warm with apple butter.

recipes.title: Banana Cinnamon Muffins
recipes.description: Delicious and moist to the last bite, these muffins will disappear quickly.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar, cinnamon and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter, banana and vanilla. Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Serve warm, drizzled with honey.

recipes.title: Raisin Bran Muffins
recipes.description: Delicious breakfast muffins that are a great source of fiber.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, wheat bran, baking powder, sugar, cinnamon and salt. Mix in the raisins. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter and vanilla. Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Serve warm with butter.

recipes.title: Raspberry Cheesecake Poppy Seed Muffins
recipes.description: Cream cheese and tart raspberries are a great match in these delicious, moist muffins.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside.

In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk, butter, cream cheese, poppy seeds and vanilla. Pour into the bowl with the dry ingredients and mix quickly to combine, about 10 seconds. Fold in the raspberries.
Pour the batter into paper lined muffin pan cups or a greased muffin pan can be used instead.
Bake until the tops are golden, about 20 minutes.

notes: Use half a cup of chopped walnuts instead of poppy seeds if desired.

recipes.title: Coffee-Flavored Eggnog
recipes.description: A warm, comforting coffee beverage with the richness of eggnog.

instructions.text: Whisk together sugar and egg yolks until light and frothy.

Pour milk in a pan and bring to a boil. Spoon a little of the milk into beaten egg and beat until blended. Gradually pour egg-milk mixture into hot milk, whisking constantly to prevent egg yolks from curdling.
Divide mixture into 4 heat-proof mugs or goblets. Stir with cinnamon sticks. Adjust sweetness, as desired. Serve hot or warm.

notes: Replace coffee with hot chocolate to turn beverage into a drink for children.

recipes.title: Fruity Smoothie with Ground Flax Seed
recipes.description: A healthy and refreshing smoothie with blueberries, banana, and nutritious flax seeds.

instructions.text: Combine blueberries, banana, yogurt, milk and ice cubes in a blender. Pulse until smooth, about 2 to 3 minutes or until smooth.
Stir in ground flax seed and transfer to a tall glass. Serve immediately.

notes: Replace banana and blueberries with strawberries, peaches, pineapple, mango, or your choice of fruit in season. Adjust sweetness as needed.

recipes.title: Fruity Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.description: A refreshing mango smoothie topped with crunchy cashew nuts.

instructions.text: Combine mango slices, apple juice or cider, yogurt and honey in a blender. Pulse until smooth, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Divide smoothie into 2 tall glasses and sprinkle with chopped nuts. Serve right away.

notes: Replace mango with cantaloupe slices, substitute apple juice with pineapple juice and increase honey to 3 tablespoons. You may also replace cashew with other nuts you prefer.

recipes.title: Mexican Breakfast Choco Drink
recipes.description: A rich, spiced hot chocolate drink with cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves.

instructions.text: Combine milk, cocoa powder, sugar, cinnamon, coffee, vanilla, nutmeg and cloves in deep pan or pot.
Cook over medium heat until solid ingredients are dissolved and mixture is nearly simmering. Do not boil chocolate drink.
Remove from heat and whisk until slightly thick.
Pour into cups and top with whipped cream. Sprinkle grated chocolate and cinnamon over cream. Serve hot.

notes: Serve with breakfast rolls and slices of fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Quick Fruity Breakfast Smoothie
recipes.description: A quick and healthy smoothie with pineapple, banana, and strawberries.

instructions.text: Combine pineapple juice, banana, yogurt, strawberries, wheat germ (if using), vanilla, banana essence and ice in a blender.
Process for 2 to 3 minutes or until smooth. Serve immediately.

notes: If recipe will be made as snack, replace yogurt with vanilla ice cream. Omit ice and wheat germ.

recipes.title: Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
recipes.description: Homemade meatballs with rice simmered in tomato and beef broth sauce.

instructions.text: Mix ground beef with rice, onion, thyme, egg, salt, pepper, and 1/2 cup tomato juice. Shape by heaping tablespoon into balls.
Brown meatballs in oil in frying pan. Pour off excess oil.
Combine remaining tomato juice and beef broth in same pan. Add meatballs, bring to boil, lower heat, and simmer for 1 hour.

flags: handwritten card - some words difficult to read

recipes.title: No-Bake Easy Easter Basket Cake
recipes.description: A totally edible, adorable Easter basket cake made with frozen poundcakes and decorated with store-bought cookies and candy.

ingredients.item: peanut-shaped peanut butter sandwich cookies (Nutter Butter)

instructions.text: In bowl set over hot, not simmering water, melt white chocolate with shortening until smooth. Dip 1 side of 1 peanut-shaped cookie in mixture; place dipped side up on wire rack. Press 1 cake decor into icing for nose. Repeat with remaining cookies. Let stand until dry, 15-20 minutes.

Roll out each Starburst to 1/4-inch thick. With clean scissors cut two 1 1/2-long bunny ears. Make small slits on 1 short side of cookie. Dip 1 tip of 2 ears into remaining chocolate; insert dipped tips into slits. Transfer semisweet chocolate to corner-snipped plastic food storage bag; pipe eyes and whiskers.

In bowl toss coconut with green food coloring and a few drops of water; set aside. Press some of M&Ms along bottom edge of cake in alternating colors. Press Cookie Stix vertically onto sides of cakes, fitting bottom tip of cookies in crevice formed where 2 M&Ms meet. Leave 1 1/2-wide vertical gap on each long side of cake for handle. Press remaining M&Ms along top edge of cake in alternating colors.

Snip corner of bag of reserved pink frosting; pipe alternating horizontal lines over cookies for basket weave. Press Bunny Rope onto sides of cake for handle; insert toothpicks through rope into cake to secure.
For extra stability prop handle up with toothpicks or long wooden skewer until cake is served. Insert bunny cookies into top of cake. Arrange coconut over cake and around cookies.

notes: Skip the bunny cookies and simply 'fill' your basket with candy eggs and other Easter goodies!
Basket handle alternative: If you are unable to find Marshmallow Bunny Ropes, flexible straws cut to fit, then threaded with marshmallows and inserted into each other can be used instead.

recipes.title: Frosty Orange Delight
recipes.description: Inspired from winner in Pillsbury's 21st Bake-Off. A frozen orange cream dessert.

ingredients.item: baked crust made with coconut cream pudding and pie filling mix

ingredients.prep_note: whipped and sweetened with 1/4 cup sugar

ingredients.item: powdered orange flavored instant breakfast drink

instructions.text: In large mixer bowl, combine cream cheese, powdered instant breakfast drink, and sugar at low speed. Beat 3 minutes at high speed until smooth and creamy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Fold in whipped cream and drained Mandarin oranges; pour over baked and cooled crust.
Freeze covered with foil, overnight. Remove from freezer 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Basic Crust
recipes.description: A basic pie crust using pudding mix for the Frosty Orange Delight.

ingredients.item: pudding and pie filling mix (not instant, 4-serving size)

instructions.text: No need to sift flour; measure by lightly spooning into cup and leveling off.
In small mixer bowl, combine all ingredients. Blend 30 seconds at low speed; blend 1 minute at medium speed.
Spread dough in ungreased 13x9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes. Cool completely.

notes: For use with Pillsbury's Best Self-Rising Flour, omit salt and the 2 tablespoons butter.

recipes.title: Berry Banana Dessert
recipes.description: Inspired from winner in Pillsbury's 21st Bake-Off. A layered frozen dessert with raspberries and bananas.

ingredients.item: baked crust made with coconut cream pudding and pie filling mix

instructions.text: In large saucepan, combine miniature marshmallows, gelatin, and reserved raspberry syrup. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until marshmallows are melted.
Chill while preparing cream cheese mixture. In large mixer bowl, combine honey, cream cheese and vanilla at low speed; beat 3 minutes at high speed until smooth and creamy.
Add yogurt and reserved marshmallow mixture; beat at medium speed 1 minute.
Slice bananas and spoon drained raspberries over baked and cooled crust. Pour filling over fruit. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set.

notes: Tip: If desired, 1 cup fresh raspberries sweetened with 1/4 cup sugar can be used for the frozen raspberries, using 1 cup water for raspberry syrup.

recipes.title: Strawberries 'n Cream Cheese Freeze
recipes.description: Adapted from winner in Pillsbury's 21st Bake-Off. A frozen strawberry cream cheese dessert.

ingredients.item: baked crust made with lemon pudding and pie filling mix

ingredients.prep_note: whipped and sweetened with 1/4 cup sugar

instructions.text: In large mixer bowl, combine cream cheese and sugar at low speed; beat at high speed for 3 minutes until smooth and creamy.
Add reserved syrup; beat 1 minute at medium speed.
Fold in strawberries and whipped cream; pour over baked and cooled crust.
Freeze covered with foil overnight. Remove from freezer 10 minutes before serving.

notes: Tip: If desired, 1 pint fresh strawberries, mashed and sweetened with 1/3 cup sugar can be used for the frozen strawberries. Use juice from mashed fresh strawberries for strawberry syrup.

recipes.title: Original Nestle Toll House Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: The classic chocolate chip cookie recipe from the Nestle Toll House package.

ingredients.item: Nestle Toll House Semi-Sweet Chocolate Morsels

instructions.text: Combine flour, baking soda and salt in small bowl.
Beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in large mixer bowl. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition; gradually beat in flour mixture.
Stir in morsels and nuts. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake in preheated 375°F oven for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand for 2 minutes; remove to wire racks to cool completely.

notes: Pan Cookie Variation: Prepare dough as above. Spread into greased 15x10-inch jelly-roll pan. Bake in preheated 375°F oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool in pan on wire rack. Makes about 4 dozen bars.

For High Altitude Baking (5,200 feet): Increase flour to 2-1/2 cups. Add 2 teaspoons water with flour and reduce both granulated sugar and brown sugar to 2/3 cup each. Bake at 375°F; drop cookies for 8 to 10 minutes and pan cookie for 17 to 19 minutes.
recipes.source_note: Nestle Toll House chocolate chip package

recipes.title: Famous Fudge
recipes.description: Classic fudge recipe from the Nestle Toll House package.

ingredients.item: Nestle Toll House Semi-Sweet Chocolate Morsels

instructions.text: Combine butter, evaporated milk, sugar and salt in medium-size, heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Boil for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.
Stir in marshmallows, morsels, nuts and vanilla. Stir vigorously for 1 minute or until marshmallows are melted.
Pour into foil-lined 8-inch square baking pan; chill until firm.

recipes.source_note: Nestle Toll House chocolate chip package

recipes.title: Old Fashion Oatmeal Cookies
recipes.description: Classic oatmeal chocolate chip cookies from the Nestle Toll House package.

ingredients.item: Nestle Toll House Semi-Sweet Chocolate Morsels

instructions.text: Combine flour, baking soda and salt in small bowl.
Beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in large mixer bowl until creamy. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Gradually beat in flour mixture.
Stir in morsels and oats. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake in preheated 350°F oven for 8 to 11 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand for 2 minutes; remove to wire racks to cool completely.

recipes.source_note: Nestle Toll House chocolate chip package

recipes.title: Keto Chicken Alfredo
recipes.description: Low Carb and Keto Chicken Alfredo Sauce is a delicious one skillet dinner the whole family will love! Tender chicken covered in a creamy, gluten free alfredo sauce.

instructions.text: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add in the avocado oil followed by the chicken. Season the chicken with all of the seasonings. Continue to cook until the chicken is cooked through, stirring occasionally. Check the internal temperature with a meat thermometer. The chicken is ready when the temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Remove from the pan and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the heavy whipping cream. Let your heavy cream cook for a few minutes until it starts to bubble. Stir in your parmesan cheese.
Remove from the heat and whisk until the cheese is completely melted.
Add your chicken back to your skillet. Stir chicken until is evenly coated with sauce. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired.

notes: Best cheese to use: Use pre-shredded parmesan cheese. The powder kind will not work. You can also grate your own.
Reheating the sauce: The best way to reheat a cream sauce is over a double boiler. This ensures slow heating so the sauce doesn't break.

recipes.title: Keto Chicken Alfredo with Broccoli Bake
recipes.description: A cheesy, creamy one-skillet keto chicken alfredo baked with broccoli and topped with melted mozzarella.

instructions.text: Melt 1 tbsp butter in a 10.25 inch oven-safe skillet (cast-iron works great).
Season sliced chicken with salt and pepper before placing in the skillet. Sear on both sides.
Cover the skillet with a lid and simmer on low until the chicken is no longer pink. Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Deglaze the pan by pouring 2 tbsp chicken broth into the hot skillet, then scraping the bits off the bottom with a wooden spoon. Leave the bits in the pan as they are extra flavorful.
Steam the broccoli in the microwave according to package directions, or steam in boiling water on the stove.
While the broccoli is cooking, add 2 tbsp butter to the skillet along with the minced garlic. Sauté for 2 minutes or until fragrant.
Add softened cream cheese, heavy whipping cream, and Italian seasoning to the minced garlic. Stir continuously with a whisk on medium heat until the ingredients are thoroughly combined.
Reduce to medium/low heat and allow the sauce to simmer, gently boiling, until the heavy whipping cream has reduced and thickened. Keep whisking so it doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan.
Once thickened, add the parmesan and pepper jack cheese. Continue to stir until the cheeses melt and the sauce is smooth.
Drain steamed broccoli. Add the chicken and broccoli to the keto alfredo sauce and stir until thoroughly combined.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on the mixture, then sprinkle basil on top.
Place the skillet in the oven on the top rack under the broiler for 1-2 minutes or until the mozzarella cheese begins to bubble.

notes: Cast-iron skillet works best for this recipe.
Baking the cheese from the top in the oven produces better results than melting on the stove.

recipes.title: Keto Chicken Alfredo Bake
recipes.description: This family-friendly Keto Chicken Alfredo with Broccoli includes layers of creamy and garlicky Alfredo sauce, steamed broccoli and cheese. Ready in 30 minutes with homemade or jarred sauce.

ingredients.prep_note: 3-4 large, patted dry, cut into bite-sized pieces
or coconut oil or avocado oil
fresh, steamed for 2 minutes in the microwave

instructions.text: Mix all of the spices (Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, and garlic powder) in a small bowl.
Add the chicken to a large bowl and pour on all of the spices. Toss the chicken to coat the pieces evenly.
Heat olive oil in a cast-iron skillet or frying pan to medium heat.
Cook the chicken breast pieces for 3-4 minutes per side, or until the chicken breasts reach 160°F (71°C). They'll continue to cook to 165°F (74°C) as they rest. Remove from the heat.
Add about 1/2 cup of alfredo sauce to the bottom of a large 9x13 inch baking dish. Spread it evenly.
Add half the chicken and the broccoli. Add 1 cup of alfredo sauce (distribute as evenly as possible) and add 1 cup of mozzarella cheese to the top.
Repeat with the remaining sauce, chicken and cheese.
Preheat the broiler to low heat. Cook the chicken alfredo bake for 2-4 minutes to melt the cheese and brown some of it.
Optional: Top the dish with fresh parsley.

notes: Can use homemade keto alfredo sauce or jarred sauce.
Cast-iron skillet works well for cooking the chicken.

recipes.title: Keto Alfredo Sauce with Zoodles
recipes.description: Creamy keto alfredo sauce served over spiralized zucchini noodles with seared chicken breast.

instructions.text: Pat chicken completely dry and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Reduce the heat of your skillet to medium-low, add 1 tablespoon of olive oil along with the chicken breasts. Sear on each side until golden and the internal temp reaches 165°F (74°C). Set chicken aside on a plate and cover with foil. After the chicken has rested for 10 minutes, slice and continue to tent until the pasta sauce is ready.
Melt butter in the skillet and add the garlic. Sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the cream, almond milk, parmesan cheese, red pepper flakes, white pepper, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Whisk as the cheese melts into the sauce, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add the zoodles and toss to coat, then quickly (so the zoodles don't get soggy) dish pasta onto plates. If you'd like your sauce a bit thicker, add 1/4 cup of additional grated parmesan.
Sprinkle with parsley, sliced chicken breast and additional parmesan. Enjoy!

notes: Not a fan of zoodles? Edamame noodles are a great substitute, especially when skipping the chicken (they're high in protein).
Chicken is totally optional. You can also use shrimp - just sear on each side until completely pink.
Watch the zoodles carefully - there's a fine line between not cooked and soggy.
Zucchini will release liquid as it cooks, which can water down your alfredo sauce. Serve right after tossing the noodles in sauce. Adding more parmesan will quickly thicken the sauce if needed.

recipes.title: Keto Chicken Alfredo with Zucchini Noodles
recipes.description: Keto chicken Alfredo with zucchini noodles tastes like a decadent low carb dinner any night of the week. Only 4.6g net carbs per serving.

instructions.text: To make the zucchini noodles, use a vegetable peeler or spiralizer. Set aside. For this recipe you can pan fry a boneless, skinless chicken breast, use leftovers or even rotisserie chicken. Just slice or cut into bite sized pieces and add at the end.
Get out a large sauté pan and heat to medium heat. Add the butter and crushed garlic. Sauté for 1 minute until the butter melts and garlic is fragrant.
Add in the cream cheese and heavy cream. Whisk until the cream cheese is melted and well combined. Then add in the grated parmesan and whisk until melted and mixed through.
Add the zucchini noodles to the pan and cook with the sauce for just a few minutes to soften them. You want them to be al dente and not too mushy.
You can either plate the noodles and top with the cooked chicken or add the sliced cooked chicken to the pan and mix in with the sauce.
Serve with extra parmesan or add some hot pepper flakes for added spice. Store leftovers in an airtight container.

notes: Can use pan-fried chicken breast, leftovers, or rotisserie chicken.
Don't overcook the zucchini noodles - they should be al dente, not mushy.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Alfredo Bake (Low Carb)
recipes.description: A delicious creamy chicken broccoli Alfredo dinner with a secret boost of protein coming from the creamy sauce!

instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly spray or grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil.
Add your cottage cheese to a small food processor to whip smooth. Mix the cottage cheese with your alfredo sauce and the garlic powder, onion powder and salt to taste.

Toss your chicken cubes with onion powder, garlic powder and salt generously. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet on medium high. Add in the chicken and cook until golden brown on sides. Remove from heat.

First add the broccoli florets to your baking dish evenly spread out. Next layer on the chicken pieces evenly. Now spread out the shredded parmesan cheese. Now the alfredo cottage cheese sauce and lastly sprinkle on the mozzarella cheese evenly.
Bake for 35 minutes – you may need to broil it for a minute or two to get it golden brown on top.

notes: Homemade Alfredo Sauce: In a medium pan, heat 1/4 cup butter and 3/4 cup heavy cream. Stir in 1 large clove minced garlic and 1/4 tsp Italian herb blend, salt and pepper to taste for 1 minute. Whisk in 1 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese until melted and combined. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve immediately.
The cottage cheese adds extra protein to the sauce while keeping it creamy.

recipes.title: Keto Chicken Alfredo Bake
recipes.description: When you make a casserole that starts with a sauce that you could straight-up drink, it is bound to be a winner. This is comfort food that never gets old.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl, combine the broccoli and cubed chicken. In a separate bowl, stir together the Alfredo sauce and xanthan gum. Toss with the broccoli and chicken.
Transfer to a casserole dish and top with the mozzarella and Parmesan cheese.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly and heated through.

notes: You can make it up to a day ahead of time and bake it when you are ready to serve.
Xanthan gum helps thicken the sauce for better coating.

recipes.title: Keto Chicken Alfredo Casserole
recipes.description: Keto Chicken Alfredo Casserole is an easy, cheesy low carb meal packed full of chicken, cheese, and cauliflower. It's the perfect keto dinner solution for feeding the whole family.

instructions.text: Steam the cauliflower. Place cut cauliflower in a microwave safe bowl with 1 cup of water. Cover with a damp paper towel and microwave on high for approximately 3-5 minutes or until the cauliflower is fork tender. Don't overcook!
Drain the cauliflower and pat dry with a paper towel. Set aside.
Cut the chicken breast into 1-inch cubes and sprinkle with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
In a skillet over medium high heat add your olive oil and the cubed chicken. Cook for approximately 10 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through. Set aside.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a small pot heat the keto alfredo sauce over medium low heat. When it is hot add 3 ounces of mozzarella cheese to the sauce and stir until it is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Prepare a 13x9 inch casserole dish by spraying it with non-stick spray then spread 1/2 cup of keto alfredo sauce on the bottom.
Add half of the cauliflower to the dish making a layer on the bottom.
Top with half of the cooked chicken. Let the chicken fill in the spaces between the cauliflower to fill the dish.
Pour 3/4 cup of keto alfredo sauce over the cauliflower and chicken.
Sprinkle 4.5 ounces of mozzarella on top.
Repeat steps using the remaining cauliflower and chicken to make a layer, followed by the remaining keto alfredo sauce, and topped with the last of the mozzarella cheese.
Place in oven and bake for 30 minutes, or until the casserole is warmed through and the cheese is fully melted.

notes: Don't overcook the cauliflower - it should be fork tender but not mushy.
Uses cauliflower instead of pasta for a low-carb base.

recipes.title: Keto Chicken Alfredo
recipes.description: Traditional Alfredo sauce served over chicken breasts and steamed broccoli! Who needs pasta?

instructions.text: Sprinkle the salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder evenly over both sides of the chicken.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the oil.
When oil is hot, add the chicken breasts and cook 5 minutes on each side or until chicken is cooked through.
While chicken is cooking, steam the broccoli on the stove or in the microwave until as tender as you'd like.
Heat a sauce pan over medium heat and add the cream, butter, garlic, salt, and pepper. Whisk constantly until the butter is melted and the mixture is hot.
Remove from the heat and stir in the shredded Parmesan. Whisk until the cheese melts fully and the sauce is smooth.
To serve, divide the broccoli between four plates and top with chicken. Drizzle with sauce.

notes: Alfredo sauce is best eaten right after preparation. It does not store or reheat well as it tends to separate.
If you'd like to add cream cheese to the sauce, stir up to 2 ounces of cream cheese in with the hot butter and cream until melted. Proceed with the Parmesan.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Squash Meatball Casserole
recipes.description: A hearty casserole featuring spaghetti squash, homemade seasoned meatballs, collard greens, spinach, and ricotta cheese topped with pasta sauce and mozzarella.

instructions.text: Cut the squash lengthwise in half; discard seeds. Place halves on a microwave-safe plate, cut side down. Microwave, uncovered, on high until tender, for 15-20 minutes. Cool slightly.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Mix 1/4 teaspoon salt with remaining seasonings (fennel, coriander, basil, oregano); add to beef, mixing lightly but thoroughly. Shape into 1-1/2 inch balls.
In a large skillet, brown meatballs over medium heat; remove from pan.
In same pan, heat oil over medium heat; sauté onion until tender, 3-4 minutes. Add garlic; cook and stir 1 minute. Stir in collard greens, spinach, ricotta and remaining salt; remove from heat.
Using a fork, separate strands of spaghetti squash; stir into greens mixture. Transfer to a greased 13x9 inch or 3-qt baking dish.
Top with the plum tomatoes, meatballs, sauce and cheese. Bake, uncovered, until meatballs are cooked through, 30-35 minutes.

notes: Diabetic Exchanges: 3 lean meat, 2 fat, 1-1/2 starch.
Uses spaghetti squash instead of pasta for a lower carb option.

recipes.title: Zucchini Boats
recipes.description: Hollowed zucchini stuffed with seasoned ground beef, vegetables, and topped with melted cheddar cheese.

instructions.text: Trim ends off zucchini. Cut zucchini in half lengthwise; scoop out pulp, leaving 1/2-inch shells. Finely chop pulp.
In a skillet, cook beef, zucchini pulp, onion, mushrooms and peppers over medium heat, breaking beef into crumbles, until meat is no longer pink; drain.
Remove from the heat. Add 1/2 cup cheese, ketchup, salt and pepper; mix well.
Spoon into the zucchini shells. Place in a greased 13x9 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese.
Bake, uncovered, at 350°F (175°C) until zucchini is tender, 25-30 minutes.
If desired, garnish with minced parsley and serve with marinara sauce.

notes: Use the scooped-out zucchini pulp in the filling for extra flavor and less waste.
Can serve with marinara sauce on the side.

recipes.title: Greek Sloppy Joes
recipes.description: A Mediterranean twist on the classic sloppy joe with oregano-seasoned beef, romaine lettuce, and crumbled feta cheese on toasted kaiser rolls.

instructions.text: In a large skillet, cook beef, onion and garlic over medium heat until beef is no longer pink, 6-8 minutes; crumble beef; drain.
Stir in tomato sauce and oregano. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, until sauce is slightly thickened, 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Place romaine on roll bottoms; top with meat mixture. Sprinkle with feta cheese; replace tops.

notes: Diabetic Exchanges: 3 lean meat, 2 starch, 1 vegetable.
For a low-carb version, serve in lettuce wraps instead of kaiser rolls.

recipes.title: Orange Beef Lettuce Wraps
recipes.description: Asian-inspired lettuce wraps featuring seasoned ground beef with orange marmalade, ginger, and sriracha, served over brown rice in crisp lettuce cups.

instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine sauce ingredients (rice vinegar, 3 tbsp water, 3 tbsp orange marmalade, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 2 cloves garlic, and Sriracha).
In a large skillet, cook beef, garlic and ginger over medium heat 8-10 minutes or until meat is no longer pink; crumble beef; drain.
Stir in soy sauce, orange juice, sugar, marmalade and pepper flakes.
In a small bowl, mix cornstarch and water; stir into pan. Cook and stir 1-2 minutes or until sauce is thickened.
To serve, fill lettuce leaves with rice; cover with beef mixture. Top with carrots and green onions; drizzle with sauce.

notes: Diabetic Exchanges: 2 starch, 2 lean meat.
Bibb or Boston lettuce works best as they form natural cups.

recipes.title: Beef Barley Skillet
recipes.description: A hearty one-skillet meal with ground beef, quick-cooking barley, and vegetables in a savory tomato-chili sauce.

instructions.text: In a large skillet, cook beef, onion, celery and green pepper over medium-high heat until beef is no longer pink and vegetables are tender, 5-7 minutes; crumble beef; drain.
Stir in tomatoes, water, barley, chili sauce, Worcestershire sauce, marjoram and pepper. Bring to a boil; reduce heat.
Simmer, uncovered, until barley is tender, 5-10 minutes. If desired, top with chopped parsley.

notes: Diabetic Exchanges: 3 lean meat, 2 starch, 1 vegetable.
Quick-cooking barley makes this a fast weeknight meal.

recipes.title: Italian Veggie Beef Soup
recipes.description: A hearty Italian-seasoned soup loaded with ground beef, cabbage, and mixed vegetables in a rich tomato-beef broth.

instructions.text: In a 6-qt. stockpot, cook ground beef and onions over medium-high heat until beef is no longer pink, 6-8 minutes, breaking up beef into crumbles; drain.
Add cabbage, mixed vegetables, tomatoes, seasonings and broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, until cabbage is crisp-tender, 10-15 minutes. Remove bay leaf.

notes: Diabetic Exchanges: 2 lean meat, 1 vegetable, 1/2 starch.
Makes a large batch - great for meal prep or freezing.

recipes.title: Easy Cuban Picadillo
recipes.description: A classic Cuban ground beef dish with olives and raisins in a savory-sweet tomato sauce, served over rice.

instructions.text: In a large skillet, cook beef with pepper and onion over medium-high heat until no longer pink, 5-7 minutes; crumble beef.
Stir in tomato sauce, olives, raisins and vinegar; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, until raisins are softened, 5-6 minutes.
Serve with rice. If desired, top with fresh cilantro to serve.

notes: Diabetic Exchanges: 3 lean meat, 2-1/2 starch, 1 fat.
The combination of olives and raisins gives this dish its signature sweet-savory Cuban flavor.

recipes.title: Brown Rice Stuffed Peppers
recipes.description: Classic stuffed peppers filled with seasoned ground beef and brown rice in a light tomato sauce.

instructions.text: Remove tops and seeds from peppers. In a stockpot, bring 10 cups water to boil; cook peppers for 5 minutes. Remove and drain.
Cook rice according to package directions.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). In a large skillet, cook beef and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink; crumble meat; drain.
Add tomato sauce, herbs, salt and pepper; cook, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Stir in rice. Remove from the heat.
Spoon rice mixture into peppers. Place in a shallow ungreased baking dish or casserole.
Bake, uncovered, until peppers are tender, 15-20 minutes.

notes: Diabetic Exchanges: 3 lean meat, 2 starch.
Brown rice adds more fiber and nutrients than white rice.

recipes.title: Best Hamburger
recipes.description: A simple, classic grilled hamburger with just salt and pepper seasoning - the way a good burger should be.

instructions.text: Shape ground beef into four 3/4-inch-thick patties.
Just before grilling, sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Grill burgers, covered, over medium heat until a thermometer reads 160°F (71°C), 5-6 minutes on each side.
Top bun bottoms with burgers. If desired, serve with lettuce, tomato, onion, bacon and mayonnaise.

notes: Season just before grilling for best results.
Internal temperature should reach 160°F (71°C) for food safety.

recipes.title: Stovetop Beef and Shells
recipes.description: A quick and satisfying pasta dish with seasoned ground beef in a simple tomato sauce, perfect for weeknight dinners.

instructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook and crumble beef with onion and garlic over medium-high heat until no longer pink, 5-7 minutes.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, sugar, salt and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, until flavors are blended, 10-15 minutes.
Stir in pasta; heat through.

notes: Diabetic Exchanges: 3 lean meat, 2 starch, 1 vegetable.
Freeze the meat and sauce mixture without the pasta shells for up to six months. Thaw in the refrigerator overnight.
Shells are ideal because they catch sauce and bits of beef, but elbows or radiatore work too.

recipes.title: Tortilla Pie
recipes.description: A layered Mexican-style pie with seasoned ground beef, ricotta cheese, and cheddar, baked between whole wheat tortillas.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). In a large skillet, cook and crumble beef with onion and garlic over medium heat until no longer pink, 4-6 minutes. Stir in spices and tomatoes. Bring to a boil; remove from heat.
In a small bowl, mix ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese and 2 tablespoons cilantro.

Place 1 tortilla in a 9-inch round baking pan coated with cooking spray. Layer with half the meat sauce, 1 tortilla, ricotta mixture, another tortilla and remaining meat sauce. Top with remaining tortilla; sprinkle with cheddar cheese and remaining cilantro.
Bake, covered, until heated through, 15-20 minutes.

notes: Diabetic Exchanges: 3 medium-fat meat, 2 starch.
Whole wheat tortillas add extra fiber to this dish.

recipes.title: Hearty Beef Sweet Potato Stew
recipes.description: A warming oven-baked stew with beef chuck, sweet potatoes, mushrooms, carrots, parsnips, and turnip. The homemade beef stock creates a rich, savory gravy.

instructions.text: In a shallow bowl, combine the flour, salt, pepper, and cayenne pepper. Add beef, a few pieces at a time, and coat evenly.
In an ovenproof Dutch oven, brown meat in oil in batches; drain.
Add the sweet potato, mushrooms, carrots, parsnips, turnip, and garlic.
Combine the stock and Worcestershire sauce; pour over vegetables. Add bay leaves.
Cover and bake at 325°F (165°C) for 2 hours or until beef and vegetables are tender.
Discard bay leaves before serving.

notes: The cayenne can be adjusted to taste (1/4 to 1/2 tsp).
Homemade beef stock makes a richer stew, but store-bought works too.

recipes.title: Beef Black Bean Soup
recipes.source_note: Taste of Home recipe collection - slow cooker
recipes.description: A hearty slow cooker soup with ground beef, black beans, and rice. The corn, tomatoes, and green chilies give it a southwestern flair.

instructions.text: In a nonstick skillet, cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink; drain.
Stir in 1 teaspoon garlic powder.
Transfer to a 5-qt. slow cooker.
Add the broth, beans, tomatoes, corn, chilies, and remaining garlic powder.
Cover and cook on high for 1 hour.
Reduce heat to low; cook 4-5 hours longer or until flavors are blended.
Just before serving, stir in rice and heat through.

notes: Freezer-friendly recipe.
If you want to freeze and reheat, consider leaving out the rice and adding it when reheating.
Prep ahead: Cook the beef the night before and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Beef Barley Lentil Soup
recipes.description: I serve this soup often to family and friends on cold nights, along with homemade rolls and a green salad. For variety, you can substitute jicama for the potatoes.

ingredients.item: 2 cans (14-1/2 ounces each) stewed tomatoes, coarsely chopped

instructions.text: In a nonstick skillet, cook beef and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink, 6-8 minutes, breaking up beef into crumbles; drain.

Transfer to a 5-qt. slow cooker. Layer with potatoes, celery, carrots, lentils and barley. Combine water, bouillon and lemon pepper; pour over vegetables. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or until vegetables and barley are tender.
Add tomatoes and salt; cook 2 hours longer.

recipes.title: Beef Lentil Soup
recipes.description: This beef lentil soup combines tender ground beef, nutritious lentils, and fresh vegetables in a hearty broth, making it a comforting one-pot meal all year long.

ingredients.item: 1 can (46 ounces) tomato or V8 juice
1 package (10 ounces) frozen chopped spinach, thawed

instructions.text: In a large stockpot, cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink, 5-7 minutes; crumble meat; drain. Add the tomato juice, water, lentils, cabbage, carrots, celery, onion, green pepper, pepper, thyme and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 1 to 1-1/2 hours or until the lentils and vegetables are tender. Add spinach and heat through. Remove bay leaf.

recipes.title: Firehouse Chili
recipes.description: When a recipe intended to serve a group of hungry people passes the firehouse test, you know it's worth making. Hearty, zesty, spicy and downright delicious, this firehouse chili will be your go-to when you need something simmering on the stove for friends and family to fill bowls at their leisure.

ingredients.item: 4 cans (16 ounces each) kidney beans, rinsed and drained
3 cans (28 ounces each) stewed tomatoes, cut up

instructions.text: In a large Dutch oven, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the ground beef in batches, stirring to brown the meat and break it into crumbles. Continue to cook until the beef is thoroughly browned with no pink showing. Remove the meat from the pot and drain the fat.
Add the onions and pepper to the Dutch oven and cook until tender and the onions are translucent. Return the meat to the pot and stir in all the remaining ingredients.

Bring the mixture to a boil and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cover the chili and cook until all the flavors are incorporated, about 1-1/2 to 2 hours. Give the chili a final stir and ladle into bowls when guests are ready to enjoy it.

recipes.title: Couscous Meatball Soup
recipes.description: This soup will warm you up and takes just 25 minutes of prep time, making it a perfect weeknight meal. &mdash;Jonathan Pace, San Francisco, California

instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine the beef, basil, oregano and salt, mixing lightly but thoroughly. Shape into 1/2-in. balls. In a large skillet coated with cooking spray, brown meatballs; drain. Remove meatballs and set aside.
In the same skillet, brown onion in oil. Add greens and kale; cook 6-7 minutes longer or until wilted.

In a Dutch oven, combine the greens mixture, meatballs, stock, vinegar, pepper flakes and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Return to a boil. Stir in couscous. Reduce heat; cover and simmer, stirring once, until couscous is tender, 10-15 minutes.

recipes.title: Feta Mushroom Burgers
recipes.description: I got this recipe from my son-in-law and I tweaked it to make it healthier. The burgers are so quick to whip up on the grill on busy nights.

ingredients.item: 3 Italian turkey sausage links (4 ounces each), casings removed
6 tablespoons crumbled feta or blue cheese
6 whole wheat hamburger buns or sourdough rolls, split

instructions.text: Combine first 4 ingredients; mix lightly but thoroughly. Shape into six 1/2-in.-thick patties. Mix vinegar and oil; brush over mushrooms.
Place burgers, mushrooms and onion on an oiled grill rack over medium heat. Grill covered until a thermometer inserted in burgers reads 160° and mushrooms and onion are tender, 4-6 minutes per side.

Fill mushroom caps with cheese; grill, covered, until cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes. Grill buns, cut side down, until toasted, 30-60 seconds. Serve burgers on buns; top with mushrooms, basil and onion.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
recipes.description: Easy spaghetti pie is a delicious and satisfying meal with all the flavor of a Sunday spaghetti supper, made weeknight-friendly.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°. Cook spaghetti according to package directions for al dente; drain.

In a large skillet, cook beef, onion and green pepper over medium heat, breaking up beef into crumbles, until beef is no longer pink, 5-7 minutes; drain. Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, seasonings and sugar.

In a large bowl, whisk egg whites, melted butter and Parmesan cheese until blended. Add spaghetti and toss to coat. Press spaghetti mixture onto bottom and up side of a greased 9-in. deep-dish pie plate, forming a crust. Spread cottage cheese onto bottom; top with beef mixture.
Bake, uncovered, 20 minutes. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Bake until heated through and cheese is melted, 5-10 minutes longer. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joe Recipe
recipes.description: Who doesn't love a classic sloppy joe recipe? Customize your homemade sloppy joes by mixing in veggies or melting cheese on top.

instructions.text: In a large skillet, cook ground beef over medium heat until nicely browned, and then drain.
Return the meat to the pan over medium heat and add in the remaining ingredients; stir to combine. Bring the mixture to a boil and then reduce heat to a low simmer.
Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, then serve them up on sliced buns—pickle chips optional.

recipes.title: Skillet Beef Tamales
recipes.description: I found something similar to this years ago and have recently added my own spin. Here’s the outcome: an easy, cheesy meal your family can't get enough of. We don't have to tell them it's healthy. —Deborah Williams, Peoria, Arizona

ingredients.item: 6 corn tortillas (6 inches), halved and cut into 1/2-inch strips

instructions.text: In a large skillet coated with cooking spray, cook beef and peppers over medium heat 6-8 minutes or until beef is no longer pink and vegetables are tender; crumble beef; drain. Stir in salsa, corn and water; bring to a boil.

Stir in tortilla strips. Reduce heat; simmer, covered, 10-15 minutes or until tortillas are softened. Sprinkle with cheese; cook, covered, 2-3 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Chili Mac Casserole
recipes.description: This cheesy casserole uses several of my family's favorite ingredients, including macaroni, kidney beans, tomatoes and cheese. Just add a leafy salad for a complete meal. —Marlene Wilson, Rolla, North Dakota

ingredients.item: 1 can (16 ounces) kidney beans, rinsed and drained
2 cups shredded reduced-fat Mexican cheese blend

instructions.text: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large nonstick skillet, cook the beef, onion and garlic over medium heat until meat is no longer pink, breaking meat into crumbles; drain. Stir in the tomatoes, beans, tomato paste, chiles and seasonings. Drain macaroni; add to beef mixture.

Transfer to a 13x9-in. baking dish coated with cooking spray. Cover and bake at 375° until bubbly, 25-30 minutes. Uncover; sprinkle with cheese. Bake until cheese is melted, 5-8 minutes longer. If desired, top with sliced green onions.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Pasta
recipes.description: Switch up your usual go-to cheeseburger dinner and make it in pasta form instead!

ingredients.item: 1-1/2 cups uncooked whole wheat penne pasta

instructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package directions.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook the beef and onion over medium heat until the beef is no longer pink. Drain the fat. Drain the pasta as well and then add it to the meat mixture.
Stir in the tomatoes, relish, mustard, ketchup, steak seasoning and seasoned salt. Bring the sauce to a boil and then reduce to a simmer and let the beef pasta cook uncovered for five minutes.
Sprinkle the top with cheese and remove the skillet from the heat. Cover and let the cheese melt. Garnish with green onions and serve.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice with Ground Beef
recipes.description: For a fast and flavorful dinner, look no further than this Spanish rice with ground beef

ingredients.item: 1 can (14-1/2 ounces) no-salt-added diced tomatoes, drained

instructions.text: In a large skillet, cook beef, onion and pepper over medium heat 6-8 minutes or until beef is no longer pink and onion is tender, breaking up beef into crumbles; drain.
Stir in tomato sauce, tomatoes and seasonings; bring to a boil. Add rice; heat through, stirring occasionally. Garnish with green onions, if desired.

recipes.title: Hearty Pita Tacos
recipes.description: A filling taco-style pita pocket loaded with ground beef, kidney beans, corn, and taco seasonings. A healthy twist on traditional tacos.

instructions.text: In a large skillet, cook the beef, red pepper and onions over medium heat until meat is no longer pink; drain.
Stir in the beans, corn, taco sauce, olives and seasonings; heat through.
Spoon 3/4 cup beef mixture into each pita half. Sprinkle with cheese. Serve with avocado and additional taco sauce if desired.

notes: Optional toppings: sliced avocado and additional taco sauce
Diabetic Exchanges: 3 lean meat, 2-1/2 starch

recipes.title: Garlic Spaghetti Squash with Meat Sauce and Tomato
recipes.description: I have reduced grains and other starches in my diet due to health reasons, so I was looking for filling, comforting meals without pasta or potatoes. When I was tinkering with this spaghetti squash recipe, I discovered something fun to eat!

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°. Cut squash lengthwise in half; remove and discard seeds. Place squash in a 13x9-in. baking pan, cut side down; add 1/2 in. hot water. Bake, uncovered, 40 minutes. Drain water from pan; turn squash cut side up. Bake until squash is tender, 5-10 minutes longer.

Meanwhile, in a large skillet, cook beef and mushrooms over medium heat until beef is no longer pink, 6-8 minutes, breaking up beef into crumbles; drain. Add half the garlic; cook and stir 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes, pasta sauce and 1/4 teaspoon pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, 15-20 minutes.

When squash is cool enough to handle, use a fork to separate strands. In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Add remaining garlic; cook and stir 1 minute. Stir in squash, salt and remaining pepper; heat through. Serve with meat sauce and, if desired, cheese.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
recipes.description: This hamburger casserole recipe is such a hit it's traveled all over the country! My mother originated the recipe in Pennsylvania, I brought it to Texas when I married, I'm still making it in California, and my daughter treats her friends to this oldie in Colorado. It's hearty, yet simple to prepare. —Helen Carmichall, Santee, California

ingredients.item: 4 pounds potatoes, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick

instructions.text: In a Dutch oven, layer half each of the meat, potatoes and onion. Sprinkle with half each of the salt and pepper. Repeat layers. Dissolve bouillon in the boiling water; pour over all. Top with tomatoes. Cover and cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender, 45-50 minutes. If desired, garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Italian Hot Dish
recipes.description: My husband had a poor perception of healthy food until he tried this beefy casserole. The combination of pasta, oregano, mushrooms and green peppers makes it a favorite healthy pasta recipe in our house.

ingredients.item: 1-1/2 cups uncooked multigrain bow tie pasta (about 4 ounces)
1/2 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese, divided

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°. Cook pasta according to package directions for al dente; drain.

Meanwhile, in a large skillet coated with cooking spray, cook and crumble beef with 1/2 cup mushrooms, onion and green pepper over medium-high heat until no longer pink, 5-7 minutes. Stir in seasonings and tomato sauce; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, covered, 15 minutes.
Place pasta in an 8-in. square baking dish coated with cooking spray. Top with meat sauce and remaining mushrooms. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese and 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese.
Bake, covered, 35 minutes. Uncover; sprinkle with remaining cheeses. Bake until heated through and cheese is melted, 5-10 minutes.

recipes.title: Lettuce-Wrap Burgers
recipes.description: A lettuce-wrap burger offers all the best parts of a burger

ingredients.item: 1/2 medium ripe avocado, peeled and cut into 8 slices

instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the beef, salt and pepper, mixing lightly but thoroughly. Shape the mixture into eight patties, each about a 1/2-inch thick. Editor's Tip: For more advice on making the perfect patties, follow these expert tips on making hamburgers.

Grill the burger patties, covered, over medium heat until a thermometer reads 160°F, three to four minutes on each side. You can also broil the burgers 3 to 4 inches from the heat source for three to four minutes per side.
Place each burger on two stacked lettuce leaves. Combine the feta and Miracle Whip, and spread the mixture over the burgers. Top with avocado, red onion and, if desired, cherry tomatoes.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak
recipes.description: Salisbury steak makes an easy, cozy weeknight dinner. One whiff of the rich ground beef and savory mushroom sauce will bring the whole family to the table!

ingredients.item: 1 can (4 ounces) mushroom stems and pieces, drained

instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the egg, cracker crumbs, onion, salt, pepper and sage. Add the beef, and mix well. Shape into two patties.
In a medium skillet, cook the patties until browned, four to five minutes per side. Drain off the excess fat. Remove to a platter, and keep warm.

In the same skillet, saute the mushrooms in butter for two minutes. Stir in the flour. Add the water and bouillon, and cook, stirring until the gravy is smooth and thickened. Add the browning sauce, if desired, and stir until the sauce is a uniform color. Return the patties to the gravy, and cook, uncovered, over low heat until heated through, about 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve the steak over mashed potatoes with plenty of gravy and mushrooms. If desired, sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Korean Beef and Rice
recipes.description: If you like bulgogi, think of this Korean beef and rice recipe as the quick-and-dirty version. Using ground beef instead of sliced steak, it's ready in just 15 minutes, start to finish.

instructions.text: In a large skillet, cook the ground beef and garlic over medium heat for six to eight minutes or until the beef is no longer pink, breaking the meat into crumbles as it cooks. Drain any excess fat from the pan.
As the beef cooks, mix the brown sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil and seasonings in a small bowl.
Stir the sauce into the beef, and heat it through. Serve the beef and sauce over cooked rice, sprinkled with the green onions.

recipes.title: Texas Tacos
recipes.description: I created this recipe by combining a bunch of taco ingredients that my kids like. Once it’s ready, I often keep the beef mixture warm in a slow cooker so the kids can quickly fill taco shells after an afternoon of rigorous soccer practice.

ingredients.item: Optional toppings: shredded lettuce, chopped fresh tomatoes and reduced-fat sour cream

instructions.text: In a Dutch oven, cook beef, red pepper and onion over medium heat until beef is no longer pink and vegetables are tender, breaking beef into crumbles, 8-10 minutes. Drain.
Stir in tomatoes, corn, tomato sauce, chili powder and salt; bring to a boil. Add rice; heat through. Serve in taco shells with toppings of your choice.

recipes.title: Arrabbiata Sauce with Zucchini Noodles
recipes.description: This popular Italian dish is flavorful and spicy. We decided to re-create one of our favorite jarred sauces and serve over zucchini pasta for a lighter, healthier meal that's naturally gluten-free. The results were amazing!

ingredients.item: 1 can (14-1/2 ounces) petite diced tomatoes, undrained
1/4 cup dry red wine or beef broth
1/2 to 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes

instructions.text: In a large saucepan, cook beef with onion and garlic over medium-high heat until no longer pink; crumble beef; 5-7 minutes. Stir in tomatoes, wine, tomato paste, honey, vinegar and seasonings; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, until flavors are blended, about 25 minutes; stir occasionally.

For noodles, trim ends of zucchini. Using a spiralizer, shave zucchini into thin strands. In a large cast-iron or other heavy skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add zucchini; cook until slightly softened, 1-2 minutes, tossing constantly with tongs (do not overcook). Sprinkle with salt. Serve with sauce. If desired, sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Unstuffed Cabbage Rolls
recipes.description: Skip the hassle of rolling cabbage leaves with this easy unstuffed cabbage roll recipe. This one-skillet dish delivers the comforting taste of traditional cabbage rolls without the extra effort.

ingredients.item: 1 medium head cabbage, coarsely chopped (about 8 cups)

instructions.text: In a large skillet, combine sauce ingredients. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer.

Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine the rice, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Crumble beef over rice mixture; mix lightly but thoroughly. Shape into 36 balls, about 1-1/4 in. in diameter. Add to simmering sauce.
Cover and simmer about 45 minutes or until the cabbage is tender. Uncover and cook for 15 minutes longer or until sauce is thickened.

recipes.title: Zucchini Lasagna
recipes.description: When life gives you zucchini, make zucchini lasagna!

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 375°F. In a large skillet, cook the ground beef and onions over high heat, stirring to break up the meat as it cooks, until beef is no longer pink, five to seven minutes. Stir in the oregano, basil, salt, pepper and tomato sauce. Bring the mixture to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer, and cook, uncovered, for five minutes. Editor’s Tip: Lean meat (such as 90% lean beef, ground chicken or ground turkey) doesn’t need to be drained. If you swapped in another ground meat like 80/20 ground beef, ground pork or ground sausage, drain and discard the grease once the meat is browned, before you add the tomato sauce and seasonings.

While the sauce simmers, whisk together the egg and cottage cheese in a small bowl. Trim the ends off the zucchini, and cut each one lengthwise into 1/4-inch-thick slices. Place the strips in a large casserole dish or bowl. Toss them with flour until they are lightly coated.

Lightly grease a 13x9-inch baking dish, and layer half of the zucchini slices. It’s OK if they overlap. Add the cottage cheese mixture, spreading it over the zucchini with a rubber spatula. Spoon half of the meat sauce over the cottage cheese mixture. Then, make a second layer by adding the remaining zucchini slices. Top them with any excess flour, the remaining meat sauce, and the mozzarella cheese.
Bake, uncovered, for about 40 minutes, until the mixture is heated through. If desired, sprinkle with additional cheese. Let the casserole stand for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

recipes.title: Meatball Cabbage Rolls
recipes.description: My mother often had these cabbage rolls simmering in her slow cooker when my family and I arrived at her house for weekend visits. The mouthwatering meatballs tucked inside made these stand out from any other cabbage rolls I've tried. —Betty Buckmaster, Muskogee, Oklahoma

instructions.text: In a Dutch oven, cook cabbage in boiling water just until leaves fall off head. Set aside 12 large leaves for rolls. (Refrigerate remaining cabbage for another use.) Cut out the thick vein from the bottom of each reserved leaf, making a V-shaped cut.

In a large bowl, combine tomato sauce, onion, rice, chili powder, garlic powder and salt. Crumble beef over mixture; mix well. Shape into 12 balls. Place 1 meatball on each cabbage leaf; overlap cut ends of leaf. Fold in sides, beginning from the cut end. Roll up completely to enclose meatball. Secure with toothpicks.
Place in a 5-qt. slow cooker. Pour remaining tomato sauce over cabbage rolls. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or until meat is no longer pink and cabbage is tender. Discard toothpicks.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Carrots
recipes.description: I love roasting carrots to bring out their sweetness. I think thyme really complements the flavor of these air-fryer carrots, but feel free to mix it up and use other herbs, like rosemary or tarragon.

instructions.text: Preheat air fryer to 375°. In a large bowl, toss first 8 ingredients. Place carrots on greased tray in air-fryer basket. Cook until carrots are crisp-tender, 18-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. If desired, sprinkle with fresh thyme.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Hard-Boiled Eggs
recipes.description: Air-fryer hard-boiled eggs make cooking eggs easier than we ever imagined, and they turn out just the same as stove-cooked eggs. It is a kitchen shortcut for the win!

instructions.text: Preheat your air fryer to 275°F. Once the air fryer is ready, place all six eggs in a single layer on the tray of your air fryer basket. Cook the eggs for 15 minutes. Editor's Tip: In our testing, we find cook times vary dramatically between brands of air fryers. As a result, be sure to check your eggs after 15 minutes. If one isn't done enough, place the remaining eggs back in the tray for a few more minutes.

Remove the eggs from the air fryer gently and rinse them under cold water. This begins halting the cooking process. Once rinsed, place the eggs in ice water until they're completely cooled. Make sure the shells don't crack against the ice.

If you're not going to use the eggs right away in a recipe, drain them and place them in the refrigerator unpeeled. Editor's Tip: You can also remove the shells before storing the eggs for easier grab-and-go access.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Pork Chops
recipes.description: Air-fryer pork chops are juicy, tender and incredibly easy to make. Paired with your favorite side dish, they’re perfect for weeknight dinners or special-occasion meals.

ingredients.item: 4  boneless pork loin chops (6 ounces each)

instructions.text: Preheat the air fryer to 375°. In a shallow bowl, stir together the almond flour, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, Creole seasoning and paprika. Coat the pork chops all over with the flour mixture, and shake off the excess. Editor’s Tip: Don't pat your pork chops dry before using them in this step. The moisture will help the seasonings and flour adhere to the meat. Also, it’s important to preheat your air fryer because, just like a hot oven, using the proper cooking temperature prevents the meat from overcooking or becoming tough.

Working in batches as needed, place chops in a single layer on a greased tray in the air-fryer basket. Spritz the chops with cooking spray. Cook the pork chops until they’re golden brown, 12 to 15 minutes, or until a thermometer reads 145°, turning the chops and spritzing with additional cooking spray halfway through cook time. Remove the pork chops, and keep warm while repeating with the remaining chops. Editor’s Tip: To keep the pork chops from drying out, check the meat's internal temperature at 12 minutes, then add more cook time as needed. If it’s close to 145°, you may only need another minute or two.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Potatoes
recipes.description: Red potatoes tossed with olive oil and herbs will become your new staple side. Crisp and fluffy air-fryer potatoes go with just about anything, from burgers to pork chops or prime rib.

ingredients.item: 2 pounds small unpeeled red potatoes, cut into wedges
1 tablespoon minced fresh rosemary or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed

instructions.text: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. In a bowl, drizzle the potatoes with olive oil, then sprinkle them with the rosemary, garlic, salt and pepper. Gently toss everything together to evenly coat the potatoes with the oil and seasonings.
Arrange the potatoes evenly on an ungreased tray in the air-fryer basket. Cook until the potatoes are golden brown and tender, 10 to 12 minutes, stirring the potatoes once.

recipes.title: Asparagus, Squash & Red Pepper Saute
recipes.description: The appealing vegetable trio is enlivened by a wine-scented saute.

ingredients.item: 2 medium yellow summer squash, halved and cut into 1/4-inch slices
6 ounces fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1-1/2-inch pieces
1/4 cup white wine or vegetable broth

instructions.text: In a large cast-iron or other heavy skillet, saute the peppers, squash and asparagus in wine and oil until crisp-tender. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Avocado Salsa
recipes.description: This avocado salsa is smooth, cool and downright refreshing. Scoop it with chips, spoon it over chicken or steak

ingredients.item: 2 cans (2-1/4 ounces each) sliced ripe olives, drained

instructions.text: Combine the corn, olives, red pepper and onion. In another bowl, mix the next seven ingredients, then pour the combination over the corn mixture, tossing to coat. Refrigerate, covered, overnight.
Just before serving, chop avocados and stir gently into the salsa. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Cucumber Tomato Salad
recipes.description: From the colors alone, you can tell this cucumber tomato salad will be bursting with fresh flavors. The feta cheese adds a layer of tang and creaminess. Chilling time aside, this recipe is ready in a matter of minutes.

ingredients.item: 1 large English cucumber, halved and sliced
1 medium red onion, halved and thinly sliced

instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the cucumber slices, grape tomato halves and sliced red onion. Add the vinaigrette and toss to coat. Refrigerate, covered, until you’re ready to serve. Just before serving, stir in the crumbled feta cheese and serve with a slotted spoon. Editor’s Tip: To avoid a watery salad, you can salt the tomatoes and cucumber first then discard the liquid. The salt draws out excess moisture.

recipes.title: Beef Daube Provencal
recipes.description: This dish is perfect on cold winter days, especially after we have been out cutting wood or white-tail hunting.  If you are lucky enough to have venison, try it here for melt-in-your-mouth goodness.

ingredients.item: 1 boneless beef chuck roast or venison roast (about 2 pounds), cut into 1-inch cubes
Hot cooked pasta or mashed potatoes

instructions.text: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Sprinkle meat with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper; brown meat in batches. Transfer beef to 4-qt. slow cooker.

Add carrot, onions, garlic and remaining salt and pepper to skillet; cook and stir until golden brown, 4-6 minutes. Add tomato paste; cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add wine, stirring to loosen browned bits from pan; bring to a boil.

Transfer meat mixture, tomatoes, broth and seasonings to slow cooker. Cook, covered, on low 5-7 hours or until tender. Discard bay leaf. Serve with hot cooked pasta or mashed potatoes. If desired, sprinkle with fresh thyme.

recipes.title: Beef Mushroom Soup
recipes.description: Leftover roast beef gives this beef mushroom soup recipe an all-day-simmered taste in a weeknight-friendly timeframe.

instructions.text: In a large saucepan, saute the onion and mushrooms in butter until the onion is tender. Remove them with a slotted spoon and set them aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour and broth until smooth. Then, gradually add the mixture to the pan. Bring them to a boil. Cook and stir until it's thickened, one to two minutes.
Add the roast beef, garlic powder, paprika, pepper, salt, pepper sauce and onion mixture. Cook and stir until they're heated through.
Serve the soup, garnished with cheese, if desired.

recipes.title: Berry-Beet Salad
recipes.description: Here's a delightfully different salad that balances the earthy flavor of beets with the natural sweetness of berries. If you prefer, substitute crumbled feta for the goat cheese.

ingredients.item: 1 each fresh red and golden beets

instructions.text: Place beets in an 8-in. square baking dish; add 1 in. of water. Cover and bake at 400° for 30-40 minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk the vinegar, oil, honey, salt and pepper; set aside. Cool beets; peel and cut into thin slices.

In a large bowl, combine the beets, berries, walnuts and shallot. Pour dressing over beet mixture and toss gently to coat. Divide salad greens among 4 serving plates. Top with beet mixture; sprinkle with cheese and basil.

recipes.title: Blackened Tilapia with Zucchini Noodles
recipes.description: I love quick and bright meals like this one-skillet wonder. The way it tastes, you'd think it takes a lot more effort, but it goes from prep to dinner table in half an hour. The recipe works well with any light fish, or even shrimp.

instructions.text: Trim ends of zucchini. Using a spiralizer, cut zucchini into thin strands.

Mix cumin, 1/2 teaspoon salt, smoked paprika, pepper and garlic powder; sprinkle mixture generously onto both sides of tilapia. In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. In batches, cook tilapia until fish just begins to flake easily with a fork, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from pan; keep warm.

In same pan, cook zucchini with garlic over medium-high heat until zucchini is slightly softened, 1-2 minutes, tossing constantly with tongs (do not overcook). Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt. Serve with tilapia and pico de gallo.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash and Carrot Soup
recipes.description: I got this golden soup recipe from a friend. Sometimes I add a few slices of red pepper to change up the flavor a bit.

ingredients.item: 1 small butternut squash (about 2 pounds), peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes (about 5 cups)

instructions.text: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat; saute onion, garlic and ginger until tender, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a 5-qt. slow cooker.
Add all remaining ingredients except cream and green onions. Cook, covered, on low until vegetables are soft, 7-9 hours.
Puree soup using an immersion blender, or cool slightly and, in batches, puree in a blender and return to slow cooker. Stir in cream; heat through. If desired, top with green onions.

recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp
recipes.description: Spice up your weeknight meals with our quick and easy Cajun shrimp recipe.

ingredients.item: 1 pound uncooked shrimp (31-40 per pound), peeled and deveined

instructions.text: In a large nonstick skillet, saute the paprika, thyme, salt, nutmeg, garlic powder and cayenne in oil for 30 seconds, stirring constantly.

Add the shrimp. Saute for two to three minutes or until the shrimp turns pink, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately. Editor's Tip: You can also look at the shape to know that your shrimp are done cooking. They're cooked if they curl into a nice C shape. Overcooked shrimp curl tightly into an O shape.

recipes.title: California Roll
recipes.description: Making your own California sushi roll is surprisingly easy. You'll need a bamboo mat, sushi rice and nori sheets to get started, and with a bit of practice, you'll be a pro in no time.

ingredients.item: 2 cups sushi rice, rinsed and drained
1 medium ripe avocado, peeled and julienned
Optional: Reduced-sodium soy sauce, prepared wasabi and pickled ginger slices

instructions.text: In a large saucepan, combine the rice and water, and let it stand for 30 minutes. This gives the rice enough time to absorb water and cook more uniformly. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low; cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender. Remove from the heat, and let the rice stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Editor's Tip: Before beginning this step, be sure to wash your rice thoroughly.
Meanwhile, in small bowl, combine the vinegar, sugar and salt, stirring until the sugar is dissolved. You'll use this mixture to season the rice.

Transfer the rice to a large shallow bowl, and drizzle with the vinegar mixture. With a wooden paddle or spoon, stir the rice with a slicing motion to cool it slightly. Cover the rice with a damp cloth to keep it from drying out. Editor's Tip: This rice mixture may be made up to two hours ahead and stored at room temperature, covered with a damp towel. Do not refrigerate or it will ruin the texture of the sushi rice.

Sprinkle toasted and black sesame seeds onto a plate, and set it aside. Place your sushi mat on a work surface so the mat rolls away from you; line the mat with plastic wrap. Place 3/4 cup rice on plastic. With moistened fingers, press the rice into an 8-inch square. It's OK to see a few tiny holes in the square. The rice will get pressed together when you roll. Top the rice square with one nori sheet. Editor's Tip: The nori has a smooth side and a rough side, which you can feel if you drag a finger across the sheet. Lay the nori on the rice with the rough side facing you and the smooth side pressed into the rice.

Arrange a small amount of cucumber, crab and avocado about 1-1/2 inches from bottom edge of the nori sheet. (Less is more here. You don't want to overstuff the roll or it won't roll into perfect pinwheels in the end.) Using your bamboo mat, roll up the rice mixture over the filling. The mat can lift and compress the mixture while rolling, bringing one side of the rice square to the other and pinching it closed along the seam. Remove the plastic wrap as you roll. You'll keep this sheet over the sushi so it doesn't dry out while you make more rolls.
